tei:div.tei:p: skabs dang po rnam mkhyen/

gnyis pa yan lag rgyas bshad la gsum ste/ yul mkhyen gsum/ thabs sbyor bzhi/ 'bras bu chos sku'o/ /dang po (yul mkhyen gsum )la gsum ste/ thob bya rnam mkhyen/ thob byed lam shes/ de'i rtsa ba gol sa dang bcas pa gzhi shes so/ /dang po (thob bya rnam mkhyen )la gnyis te/ bsam pa sems bskyed/ sbyor ba sgrub pa'o// sems bskyed/ dang po (bsam pa sems bskyed )la/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung don gnyis/ dang po (spyi don )la gsum ste/ mtshan nyid/ mtshon bya/ mtshan gzhi'o/ /dang po (mtshan nyid )ni/ gzhan don du rdzogs byang la dmigs pa'i sems te/ don gnyis ldan pa'i sems byung ba/ /zhes pas so// gnyis pa (mtshon bya )ni/ shes bya thams cad khong du chub pas na byang chub de'i rgyur tshogs bsags pas na sems de rgyu tshad med pa las byung bas na bskyed pa zhes bya'o// gsum pa (mtshan gzhi )la gnyis te/ don dam sems bskyed dang*/ kun rdzob sems bskyed do/ /dang po (don dam sems bskyed )la bzhi ste/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams/ thob tshul lo/ /dang po (ngo bo )ni/ don dam chos dbyings kyi byang chub la dmigs shing zag med yid shes kyi ngo bor skyes pa de'o/ /gnyis pa (dbye ba )ni/ lhag bsam dag pa dang*/ rnam par smin pa dang*/ sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed do/ /gsum pa (sa mtshams )ni/ snga ma sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar dang*/ gnyis pa dag pa sa gsum/ gsum pa sangs rgyas kyi sar bzhag go /bzhi pa (thob tshul )la/ rgyu ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rab mnyes byas// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab bsags// chos la mi rtog ye shes ni// skyes phyir de ni dam par 'dod// ces gsungs pas/ dam pa gsum dang*/ rkyen ni/ sgom stobs kyis thob pa yin no// gnyis pa (kun rdzob sems bskyed )la'ang bzhi las/ dang po ngo bo ni/ kun rdzob chos can gyi byang chub la dmigs pa'i sems byung yin la/ de yang smon pa ni 'dod pa dang*/

'jug pa ni sems pa yin no// gnyis pa (dbye ba )ni/ gtso che ba'i dbang du byas nas smon 'jug gnyis las/ dang po ni/ byang sems kyi bslab bya slob par smon pa tsam dang*/ phyi ma ni khas blangs shing zhugs pa yin no/ /de la thogs med sku mched kyis ni sems bskyed pa dang de'i sdom pa zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad nas thog mar sems bskyed la phyis sdom pa cho gas len pa de gnyis gzhi mthun mi srid par bzhed do/ /smon 'jug gi tha snyad 'di ni zhi ba lhas bzhed cing*/ de'i lugs la yang smon sems ni cho ga la mi ltos la/ 'jug pa ni nges par ltos dgos par bzhed do/ /'on kyang smon 'jug so sor ma phye bar cho gas len pa zhig kyang 'byung ngo*// gsum pa (sa mtshams )ni/ smon sems ni sbyor lam yan chad la mi 'gro la/ 'jug sems ni mngon gyur dang bag nyal gyi sgo nas byang sems thams cad la yod do// bzhi pa (thob tshul )la/ rgyu ni/ grogs stobs rgyu stobs rtsa ba'i stobs/ /thos stobs dge ba goms pa las/ /zhes dang*/ rkyen ni/ gzhan gyis bstan pa'i sems bskyed bshad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa gzhung gi don la bzhi ste/ mtshan nyid/ dmigs yul/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams/ dang po ni/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir// yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod// sems bskyed ni 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi rgyu yin pas thog mar 'chad la/ de las kyang dang por byung ba'i dbang du byas nas smon pa sems bskyed pa nyid gsungs pa 'di lta ste/ sems bskyed pa ni sems can gzhan gyi don gyi phyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa'am 'dun pa'am smon pa'o/ /mdo ni/ byang sems ci nas bdag bla med byang chub tu 'tshang rgya ba dang gzhan gyi don bsgrub par bya'o zhes de ltar don du gnyer bar byed pa yin no zhes/ 'di ltar sems byung la sems bskyed pa'i sgra mi 'jug go zhe na/

de ni sgra yangs pa'i dbang du byas pas skyon med do// gnyis pa (dmigs yul )ni/ de dang de ni mdo bzhin du// bsdus dang rgyas pa'i sgo nas brjod// 'o na sems bskyed de'i yul du gyur pa'i rdzogs byang ni gang*/ gzhan don ni gang zhe na/ lan ni/ thob bya rdzogs byang de dang las su bya ba gzhan don de ni blo gros mi zad pa dang sdong po bkod pa'i mdo sogs dang mthun par rgyas 'bring bsdus pa las gsungs pa bzhin du bsdus dang rgyas pa'i sgo nas brjod de/ shā ri'i bu 'di la byang sems chen po chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas sher phyin la brtson par bya'o/ /zhes bsdus pa dang*/ shā ri'i bu 'di la byang sems chen po mi gnas pa'i tshul gyis yum la gnas te sbyin par bya ba dang sbyin pa po dang len pa po mi dmigs pa'i phyir yongs su gtong ba med pa'i tshul gyis sbyin pa'i phar phyin yongs su grub par bya'o/ /zhes pha rol tu phyin pa gzhan rnams la yang sbyar te rgyas par bshad pa'i sgo nas shes par bya ba'i byang chub bstan pa dang*/ sems can gang zhig yod pa de dag thams cad phung po lhag ma med pa'i dbyings su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'dod pas sher phyin 'di nyid sgrub par bya'o/ /zhes bsdus pa dang*/ sems can ser sna can rnams ni sbyin pa la 'god pa nas shes rab 'chal pa rnams ni shes rab phun sum tshogs pa la 'god par 'dod pa'i byang sems kyi yum la bslab par bya'o/ /zhes rgyas bshad kyi sgo nas las su bya ba gzhan don bstan to/ /gzhung tshig gnyis po 'di'i de dang zhes pas rang nyid lam la 'jug pa dang*/ de ni zhes pas gzhan lam la gzhug pa'i 'jug pa sems bskyed bstan par rtogs so// gsum pa (dbye ba )ni/ de yang sa gser zla ba me// gter dang rin chen 'byung gnas mtsho// rdo rje ri sman bshes gnyen dang*// yid bzhin nor bu nyi ma glu//

rgyal po mdzod dang lam po che// bzhon pa bkod ma'i chu dang ni// sgra snyan chu bo sprin rnams kyis// rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis so// de ltar sems bskyed pa de la du zhig yod ce na/ 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi dbang du byas nas mdo gzhan gyi rjes su 'brangs te dpe nyer gnyis dang*/ yum gyi dngos bstan gyi grogs nyer gnyis dang*/ slob dpon gyis mdzad pa'i chos mthun nyer gnyis rnams sbyar te bshad pa ni/ de yang grogs 'dun pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni dpe sa lta bu yin te/ chos mthun chos dkar po thams cad kyi gzhi yin pas so/ /de bzhin du sbyar te/ bsam pa dang ldan pa ni gser dang 'dra ste byang chub kyi bar du mi 'gyur bas so/ /lhag bsam dang ldan pa ni zla ba tshes pa lta bu yin te dge ba'i chos 'phel bar 'gyur bas so/ /sbyor ba dang ldan pa ni me lta bu yin te nyon mongs pa'i bud shing bsreg pas so/ /sbyin pa dang ldan pa ni gter dang 'dra ste sems can thams cad tshim par byed pas so/ /tshul khrims dang ldan pa ni rin po che'i 'byung gnas dang 'dra ste yon tan thams cad 'byung bas so/ /bzod pa dang ldan pa ni rgya mtsho lta bu yin te gting mi 'khrug pas so/ /brtson 'grus dang ldan pa ni rdo rje lta bu yin te bdud las kyis mi 'byed pas so/ /bsam gtan dang ldan pa ni ri bo lta bu yin te rnam g.yeng gis mi bskyod pas so/ /shes rab dang ldan pa ni sman lta bu yin te sgrib gnyis kyi nad zhi bar byed pas so/ /bsngo ba'i thabs mkhas dang ldan pa ni bshes gnyen dang 'dra ste sems can gyi don mi gtong bas so/ /smon lam chen po bcu sogs dang ldan pa ni yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yin te smon pa 'grub pas so/ /stobs dang ldan pa ni nyi ma lta bu yin te gdul bya'i lo thog smin par byed pas so/ /ye shes dang ldan pa ni dri za'i glu lta bu yin te gdul bya 'dun pa'i chos ston pas so/

/mngon shes dang ldan pa ni rgyal po lta bu yin te mthu thogs pa med pas gzhan don bsgrub pas so/ /tshogs gnyis dang ldan pa ni bang mdzod dang 'dra ste bsod nams dang ye shes kyi gnas yin pas so/ /byang phyogs so bdun dang ldan pa ni lam po che lta bu yin te 'phags pa rnams gshegs pas so/ /snying rje lhag mthong dang ldan pa ni bzhon pa lta bu yin te srid zhi gang du yang mi gnas par 'gro bas so/ /gzungs spobs dang ldan pa ni bkod ma'i chu dang ni 'dra ste chos 'dzin cing mi bzad pas so/ /chos kyi dga' ston dang ldan pa ni sgra snyan lta bu yin te thar pa 'dod pa la snyan par sgrogs pas so/ /bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam dang ldan pa ni chu bo lta bu yin te gzhan don rgyun mi 'chad pas so/ /chos sku dang ldan pa ni 'byor pa 'byung ba'i rgyu sprin lta bu yin te sprul pa'i sku'i spyod lam rnams 'byung bas so/ /de ltar rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis so// bzhi pa (sa mtshams )ni/ sems bskyed dang po gsum ni tshogs lam/ de 'og gcig ni sbyor lam/ de 'og bcu ni sa bcu/ de 'og lnga ni dag pa'i khyad par gyi lam/ de 'og gsum ni sbyor dngos mjug gi sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi sas bsdus so// gdams ngag gnyis pa sbyor ba sgrub pa la gsum ste/ sgrub pa'i thabs ston pa gdams ngag /de bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu nges 'byed yan lag /sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo bshad pa'o/ /dang po (sgrub pa'i thabs ston pa gdams ngag )la gnyis te/ gdams ngag bcu spyir bstan/ dge 'dun dkon mchog bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po (gdams ngag bcu spyir bstan pa )la/ bsdus te gzhung dang sbyar/ so sor phye ste bshad pa gnyis kyi/ dang po (bsdus te gzhung dang sbyar ba )ni/ sgrub dang bden pa rnams dang ni// sangs rgyas la sogs dkon mchog gsum// ma zhen yongs su mi ngal dang*// lam ni yongs su 'dzin pa dang*//

spyan lnga dang ni mngon shes kyi// yon tan drug dang mthong lam dang*// sgom zhes bya la gdams ngag ni// bcu yi bdag nyid shes par bya// sems bskyed dang ldan pa'i gang zag des yon tan ma thob pa thob byed kyi gdams ngag don du gnyer ba 'byung la/ de yang gdams ngag phal pa ni nyan rang dang chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin ma thob pa rnams kyis gdams pa las thob mod/ khyad par can ni theg pa chen po'i tshogs lam la gnas shing chos kyi tshig don mi brjed par 'dzin nus pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa'i skyes bu de la/ sangs rgyas sprul pa'i skus mngon sum du rnal 'byor 'di dang 'di dag nyams su longs shig ces gdams par mdzad pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i gdams ngag la dbye na/ kun rdzob snang tsam pa de nyid rang bzhin med pa nyid du rtogs shig /ces bsgrub bya'i gtso bo dang*/ chos kyi bdag med pa'i rnam pa can gyi yul bden pa bzhi po rnams dang ni/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dkon mchog gsum la mngon zhen med par bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i dkon mchog gsum la dang*/ rang gi bde ba la ma zhen par bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus la dang*/ gnyen po'i stobs bsgrub par bya ba'i yongs su mi ngal ba'i brtson 'grus la dang*/ lam gzhan du mi 'gro bar bya ba'i rang gi lam ni yongs su 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus la dang*/ gzhan dring mi 'jog par bya ba'i spyan lnga dang ni/ gzhan don bya ba'i mngon shes kyi yon tan drug la dang*/ rdzogs byang gi skal mnyam gyi rgyu mthong lam dang*/ sgom lam zhes bya ba la 'doms pa ste de ltar gdams ngag ni bcu'i bdag nyid du shes par bya'o// gnyis pa so sor bshad pa la gsum ste/ sgrub pa'i dmigs yul bden pa la 'doms pa/ sgrub pa'i rten dkon mchog gsum la 'doms pa/ sgrub pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu la 'doms pa'o// dang po (sgrub pa'i dmigs yul bden pa la 'doms pa )la/

gtso bo bden gnyis/ dman pa bden bzhi'o/ /dang po (gtso bo bden gnyis )ni/ byang sems kyi sgrub pa de shes rab kyi khyad par du 'phags pa bden gnyis las mi 'da' ba dang*/ thabs kyi khyad par du 'phags pa snying rje dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis zin pa yin la/ de yang kun rdzob las mi 'da' bar rjes thob tu bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog cing*/ don dam las mi 'da' bar mnyam bzhag tu ye shes kyi tshogs bsog pa yin no// des na bden pa gnyis la mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum/ dang po (mtshan nyid )la/don dam gyi mtshan nyid ni/ rang bzhin gyi spros pa dang bral bar gnas pa ste/ zla ba'i snying pos zhus pa'i mdo las/ rang bzhin med cing spros med pa// de nyid don dam spyod yul lo// zhes gsungs so/ /kun rdzob kyi mtshan nyid ni/ rten 'brel sna tshogs su snang ba ste/ bden gnyis las/ ji ltar snang ba 'di kho na// kun rdzob ces gsungs so// gnyis pa (mtshon bya )ni/ bslu bar yod pas na kun rdzob bden pa/ nges pa'i don du yod pas na don dam bden pa zhes bya'o// gsum pa (mtshan gzhi )la gnyis las/ dang po (kun rdzob kyi mtshan gzhi )ni/ ma rig pas bslad pa'i shes pa dang der snang gi cha thams cad yin la/ dbye na/ zla ba gnyis 'dzin lta bu log pa'i kun rdzob dang*/ bum pa dang ka ba 'dzin pa lta bu yang dag kun rdzob gnyis so// gnyis pa (don dam gyi mtshan gzhi )ni/ 'khrul bral mi rtog pa'i shes pa dang de'i yul thams cad de/ dbye na/ spros bral phyogs re rtogs pa rnam grangs pa'i don dam dang*/ spros pa ma lus pa dang bral bar rtogs pa rnam grangs pa ma yin pa'i don dam gnyis su yod do// mdo ni/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ji ltar bslab par bya/ zhes dris pa'i lan du/ shā ri'i bu/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' yod bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' chen po yang dag par rjes su mi mthong zhes pa nas/

byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni ming tsam mo/ /zhes bya ba'i bar gyis shes rab khyad par du 'phags pa bstan/ yang shā ri'i bu/ de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpas shes rab nyin gcig bsgoms pa gang yin pa des ni/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi shes rab zil gyis gnon par byed do/ /zhes pa nas/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi shes rab ni de lta ma yin no/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis thabs khyad par du 'phags pa bstan to// gnyis pa dman pa bden bzhi la 'doms pa ni/ nyan thos kyis ni bden bzhi mi rtag sogs bcu drug tu mngon par zhen cing chags pa'i tshul gyis nyams su len pa yin la/ 'dir ni zhen pa de dang bral ba'i sgo nas stong pa nyid dang mtshungs ldan du nyams su longs zhes 'doms pa yin no// 'dir bden bzhi'i mtha' dpyad pa la gnyis te/ 'khor ba rgyu 'bras/ rnam byang rgyu 'bras so/ /dang po ('khor ba rgyu 'bras )la/ shes bya 'bras bu/ spang bya rgyu gnyis/ dang po (shes bya 'bras bu+u )la gnyis te/ mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi'o/ /dang po (mtshan nyid )ni/ gzhan la mi ltos par 'jig pas mi rtag pa/ gnod pa'i ngo bor gyur pas sdug bsngal ba/ rang bzhin med pas na stong pa/ 'dzin pa dang bral bas bdag med pa ste rnam pa bzhi'o/ /de dag gi stong bdag med gnyis ni shes bya thams cad dang*/ mi rtag pa ni 'dus byas thams cad dang*/ sdug bsngal ni zag bcas thams cad la rjes su 'gro'o//

gnyis pa (mtshan gzhi )ni/ las nyon gyi rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu sems can dang*/ de'i bdag 'bras snod kyi 'jig rten gnyis so/ /des na 'dir skye ba po sems can/ gang du skye ba'i snod/ de dag 'jal byed bshad pa'o/ /dang po (skye ba po sems can )la/ dbye ba/ skye ba gnas pa/ 'chi 'pho ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po (dbye ba )ni/ dmyal ba/ yi dwags/ dud 'gro/ mi/ lha ste 'gro ba lnga dang*/ bar srid rnams so// gnyis pa (skye ba gnas pa )ni/ sems can de dag skye ba'i tshul ni/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis yin zhing gnas pa dang 'tsho ba'i rgyu ni zas yin la/ de la ni 'dod khams nyid la yod cing dri ro reg bya'i ngo bor gyur pa'i khams kyi zas dang*/ khams gsum char na yod pa'i reg pa'i zas yul dbang rnam shes 'dus pa las byung ba dang*/ sems pa'i zas yid kyi las dang*/ rnam par shes pa'i zas te thams cad zag bcas kho na yin no/ /bzhi po de las snga ma gnyis kyis tshe 'di'i lus sems gso bar byed/ phyi ma gnyis kyis yang srid 'phen 'grub byed do/ /sems can rnams 'chi 'pho ba'i tshul ni/ rten srog gi dbang po 'gags pas brten pa yid shes nyid 'pho ba yin no/ /gnyis pa (gang du skye ba'i snod )ni/ rten dkyil 'khor gsum/ lhun po ri bdun/ khor yug gi ri/ gling bcu gnyis/ nyi zla skar ma 'dod lha'i gnas drug gzugs khams kyi gnas bcu bdun rnams so// gsum pa (de dag 'jal byed bshad pa )la/ yul dus gnyis las/ dang po (yul )ni/ phra rab kyi rdul dang*/ rdul phran dang*/ lcags rdul/ chu rdul/ ri bong gi rdul/ lug rdul/ glang rdul/ nyi zer rdul/ sro ma shig nas sor tshigs rnams gong nas gong du bdun 'gyur/ de nyi shu bzhi la khru/ de bzhi la 'dom gang*/ de lnga brgya la rgyang grags/ de brgyad la dpag tshad do// gnyis pa (dus )ni/ se gol myur ba gcig la drug cu rtsa bzhir phye ba'i cha gcig la dus mtha'i skad cig

de brgya nyi shu la de'i skad cig de drug cu la thang gcig dang yud tsam nyin zhag zla ba rnams ni gong nas gong du sum cu 'gyur/ de zhag mi thub dang bcas pa bcu gnyis la lo gcig yin no// gnyis pa spang bya rgyu la gnyis te/ mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi'o/ /dang po (mtshan nyid )ni/ srid pa len par byed pas rgyu/ sdug bsngal ma lus 'byung bas kun 'byung*/ 'bras bu drag tu bskyed pas rab bskyed/ sdug bsngal snga ma 'dor zhing phyi ma 'dren pas rkyen te rnam pa bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa (mtshan gzhi )ni/ sdug bden gyi rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa de'o/ /rgyur 'gyur tshul ni/ 'phen byed kyis rnam smin dang 'grub byed kyis skal mnyam kyi rgyur 'gyur/ las nyon gnyis ka snod kyi byed rgyur 'gyur ro// 'dir nyon mongs dang las kyi mtha' dpyad pa'i/ dang po (nyon mongs )la bzhi ste/ rgyu/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ rgyas par 'gyur tshul lo/ /dang po (rgyu )ni/ nyon mongs pa'i sa bon ma spangs pa/ gang la dmigs nas skye ba'i yul nye bar gnas pa/ de la dmigs pa'i tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid byed de gsum yin no/ /gnyis pa (ngo bo )ni/ sems byung gang zhig de byung ba na sems kyi rgyud rab tu ma zhi bar byas pa'o// gsum pa (dbye ba )la gsum ste/ ngo bo dang*/ spong tshul dang*/ ming gi sgo nas phye ba'o/ /dang po (ngo bo'i sgo nas phye ba )la/ rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa dang*/ nyon mongs can nye nyon gnyis yod pa'i snga ma la ni/ 'dod chags/ khong khro/ nga rgyal/ ma rig pa/ the tshom/ lta ba dang drug /lta ba la dbye na/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba/ mthar 'dzin lta ba/ log lta/ lta ba mchog 'dzin/ tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin te lngar phye bas bcu'o// gnyis pa (spong tshul gyi sgo nas phye ba )la/ grub mtha'i blo bsgyur ba las byung ba nyon mongs pa kun brtags kyi cha mthong spangs dang*/ de la ma ltos pa lhan skyes kyi cha sgom spangs yin pa gnyis las/

dang po la/ theg dman ltar na/ 'dod pa khams nas sdug bsngal mthong spangs la bcu/ kun 'byung dang 'gog pa mthong spangs gnyis la lta ba dang po gnyis phyi ma gcig ma gtogs pa bdun bdun/ lam mthong spangs la lta ba dang po gnyis ma gtogs pa'i brgyad yin la/ theg chen ltar na/ 'dod pa khams su bden bzhi la dmigs pa'i nyon mongs bcu bcu/ khams gong mar khong khro ma gtogs pa dgu dgu yin no// sgom spangs la/ theg dman ltar na/ 'dod par 'dod chags khong khro nga rgyal ma rig pa bzhi/ khams gong na khong khro ma gtogs pa'o/ /theg chen ltar na/ snga ma rnams kyi steng du 'jig mthar gnyis bsnan pa de'o/ /lugs gnyis gang yin na'ang sgom spangs la/ sa dgu na nyon mongs pa re re la chung 'bring chen po gsum gsum de re re la chung 'bring chen po gsum gsum du phye bas dgu dgu ru yod do/ /khams gong na khong khro med pa'i rgyu mtshan ni kun nas mnar sems pa'i rgyu dgu dang bral bas yin no// gsum pa (ming gi sgo nas phye ba )la/ kun sbyor/ 'ching ba/ bag la nyal/ nye ba'i nyon mongs pa/ kun dkris/ chu bo/ sbyor ba/ nye bar len pa/ mdud pa/ sgrib pa/ tha ba/ dri ma/ sdig pa/ zug rngu/ ci yang*/ nyes spyod/ zag pa/ 'phongs pa/ yongs gdung*/ 'khrug pa/ 'thab mo/ rims nad/ nags sbyor/ gegs te nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o// bzhi pa (rgyas par 'gyur tshul )la/ dmigs pa'i sgo nas dang*/ mtshungs ldan gyi sgo nas rgyas 'gyur gnyis/ dang po (dmigs pa'i sgo nas rgyas 'gyur )ni/ sdug kun mthong bas spang bar bya ba'i lta ba rnams dang*/ the tshom ma rig pa ste kun 'gro rnams ni khams gsum gyi spang bya rigs lnga la dmigs nas rgyas par 'gyur la/ de las gzhan pa'i nyon mongs rnams ni rang rang gi rigs la dmigs nas rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang zag med dang khams gong ma la dmigs pa'i nyon mongs pa rnams ni rgyas par mi 'gyur te dmigs pa de sred pa dang bdag ltas bdag gir ma byas pa'i phyir ro/

/theg dman ltar na nyon mongs kyi zag med dngos la dmigs par 'dod la/ theg chen ltar na dngos la dmigs mi nus so// gnyis pa (mtshungs ldan gyi sgo nas rgyas 'gyur )ni/ nyon mongs gang zhig chos gang dang mtshungs par ldan pa de ni ma spangs kyi bar du de dang mtshungs ldan gyi sgo nas rgyas par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa las kyi kun 'byung la/ theg chen pas ni kun gzhi'i rnam shes la las kyi sa bon gnas par 'dod/ /bye mdo gnyis las kyi rten yid shes su 'dod par mtshungs la/ bye smras las kyi rgyun thob pa'i rdzas kyi ldan pa dang*/ mdo sde pas chud mi 'dza' ba'i rdzas kyi ldan par 'dod do// de lta'i las la dbye na/ bsam pa yid kyi las dang*/ des kun nas bslangs pa'i lus ngag gi las gnyis so/ /kun slong la ni bya ba de dang por 'phen byed kyi rgyu'i kun slong dang*/ bya ba de dang lhan cig tu 'jug pa dus kyi kun slong gnyis yin zhing*/ rgyu'i kun slong dge ba las dus kyi kun slong mi dge ba 'byung ba sogs kyang yod do// rnam smin gyi sgo nas dbye na/ nges pa'i las/ ma nges pa'i las gnyis/ snga ma la mthong chos myong 'gyur/ skye gnas myong 'gyur/ lan grangs gzhan du myong 'gyur dang gsum du phye/ de yang mthong chos myong 'gyur gyi rnam smin rdzogs par byed pa kho na yin la/ phyi ma gnyis kyis ni rnam smin 'phen par yang byed do/ /'phen byed ni skya ris dang rdzogs byed ni mtshon bkye ba lta bu yin no/ /las dkar la rnam smin dkar ba khams gong ma'i dge ba 'bras bu sa gzhan du mi g.yo ba dang*/ gnag la rnam smin gnag pa mi dge ba bsod nams ma yin pa dang*/ dkar nag tu gyur la rnam smin yang 'dres pa 'dod pa'i dge ba bsod nams kyi las dang*/ mi gnag cing mi dkar la rnam smin gnag pa mi 'byung ba zag med kyi las rnams su phye'o/ /zag med kyi las 'di ni kun 'byung du mi bzhag la/

kun 'byung yin na mi dge ba dang dge ba zag bcas gang rung yin cing*/ sdug bden yin na ma sgribs lung ma bstan yin dgos so// gnyis pa rnam byang rgyu 'bras la gnyis te/ thob bya 'bras bu/ bsten bya rgyu'o/ /dang po (thob bya 'bras bu )la gnyis te/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi'o/ /dang po (mtshan nyid )ni/ nyon mongs spangs pas 'gog pa/ sdug bsngal bral bas zhi ba/ /de las lhag pa'i 'dod bya med pas gya nom/ spangs pa slar mi zlog pas nges par 'byung ba dang bzhi'o// gnyis pa (mtshan gzhi )ni/ dgag gzhi de bzhin nyid kyi steng du 'gog byed bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi dgag bya glo bur gyi dri ma dag pa la byed/ de ni bral ba'i 'bras bu yin pas rgyu mtshan nyid pa med do// de la dbye na/ brda'i 'gog pa/ don dam pa'i 'gog pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ lam zag bcas kyis spang bya'i sa bon nyams smad pa la byed/ gnyis pa ni lam zag med kyis spang bya'i sa bon drungs phyung pa la byed cing*/ de la yang yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ ma rdzogs pa dang*/ khyad par du 'phags pa dang gsum du yod do// gnyis pa bsten bya lam la/ mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi gnyis kyi/dang po (mtshan nyid )ni/ thar pa'i grong khyer du bgrod par byed pas lam/ sems phyin ci ma log par sgrub pas bsgrub pa/ sgrib pa'i gnyen po byed pas rigs pa/ rtag pa dam pa'i gnas su 'byin pas nges 'byin te bzhi'o// gnyis pa (mtshan gzhi )ni/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab 'khor bcas so/ /de lta'i bden bzhi'i go rim ni mngon par rtogs pa ji ltar skye ba'i tshul dang mthun par bstan pa yin no// gnyis pa sgrub pa'i rten dkon mchog gsum la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag la gnyis te/ dkon mchog gi ngo bo/ skyabs gnas su 'jog tshul lo/ /dang po (dkon mchog gi ngo bo )la/ 1 sangs rgyas ni/ don dam par yon tan brgyad ldan gyi chos sku ste/

rang bzhin rnam dag 'dus ma byas pa/ glo bur rnam dag lhun gyis grub pa/ sangs rgyas nang phan tshun ma gtogs pa gzhan gyis mi rtogs pa ste rang don gyi yon tan dang*/ shes bya ji lta ba mkhyen pa dang*/ de ltar ma rtogs pa rnams la thugs brtse ba dang*/ de gnyis kyi sems can gyi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa 'joms pa ni nus pa ste/ gzhan don gyi yon tan rnams so// 2 chos ni/ don dam par yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i ye shes te/ spros pa'i mtha' bzhi dang bral bas bsam du med pa dang*/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa gnyis su med pa dang*/ khams gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa med pa ste/ gang zhig chags pa dang bral ba 'gog bden gyi yon tan dang*/ gzod ma nas zhi ba'i dag pa dang*/ gnas lugs mngon sum du rtogs pa gsal ba dang*/ spang bya'i sa bon drungs 'byin par byed pas gnyen po ste gang gis chags pa dang bral bar byed pa'i lam bden gyi yon tan no// 3 dge 'dun ni/ yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i skyes bu ste/ sems rang bzhin 'od gsal ji lta bar rig pa dang*/ de sems can thams cad la khyab par mthong ba ji snyed pa rig pa dang*/ de bde bar gshegs pa'i snying por mthong ba nang rig pa ste/ rig pa'i yon tan dang*/ ye shes de'i dang po chags pa'i dri ma las grol ba dang*/ gnyis pa thogs pa'i sgrib pa las grol ba dang*/ des na lus can kun gyi skyabs gnas su gyur pas dman pa'i sgrib pa las grol ba ste/ grol ba'i yon tan no// theg dman gyi sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun ni lam bden dang*/ chos ni lhag med kyi myang 'das la 'dod do// gnyis pa (skyabs gnas su 'jog tshul )ni/ mthar thug sangs rgyas nyid skyabs gnas su 'jog la/ gnas skabs su ni gsum char skyabs gnas su 'jog ste/ ston pa'i bstan pa bslab don dang*// theg pa gsum dang byed gsum la// mos pa rnams kyi dbang byas nas// skyabs gsum rnam par bzhag pa yin//

zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gsum pa sgrub pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu la 'doms pa la/ sgrub pa'i mi mthun phyogs spong ba'i brtson 'grus ni go sla bar zad do// sgrub pa la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa spyan lnga la 'doms pa ni/ sha'i spyan/ lha'i spyan/ shes rab kyi spyan/ chos kyi spyan/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan no/ /de dag gis rim par dpag tshad brgya stong tshun gyi dngos po dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba'i tshul dang*/ chos nyid kyi don ji lta ba dang*/ rang dang spangs rtogs mnyam pa'i rgyud tshod dang*/ chos thams cad mngon par byang chub par mthong ngo*/ /dang po gnyis ni/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba yin la/ de dag gi rgyu ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug yin no/ /sa mtshams ni/ dang po gnyis tshogs sbyor na'ang yod/ bar pa gnyis sa bcu'i mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob na'ang yod/ mtha' ma gcig ni sangs rgyas kyi sa nyid na yod do// gzhan don sgrub pa'i rgyu mngon shes drug la 'doms pa ni/ rdzu 'phrul dang*/ lha'i rna ba dang*/ gzhan gyi sems shes pa dang*/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa dang*/ mngon par 'du byed dang bcas pa lha'i mig dang*/ zag pa zad pa shes pa'i mngon shes dang drug go /de las dang po ni/ lus rnam par dag pa dang*/ gnyis pa ni ngag rnam par dag pa dang*/ phyi ma bzhi sems rnam par dag pa yin no/ /sa mtshams ni/ dang po lnga so skye dang thun mong ba yin la/ phyi ma ni 'phags pa'i sa thob nas 'byung ngo*// sgrub pa mthar thug pa'i rgyu mthong lam dang sgom lam la 'doms pa ni 'og nas 'chad do// mdor na gdams ngag de dag thams cad yul yul can gnyis su med pa'i sgo nas chos nyid las mi 'da' bar 'doms pa yin no// mdo ni/ gzugs stong pa nyid la brtson na zhes sogs dang*/ gzugs skye ba zhes sogs dang*/ shā ri'i bu stong pa nyid ni mi skye mi 'gag ces sogs dang*/ shā ri'i bu gzhan yang sbyin pa'i phar phyin la brtson zhes sogs kyi go rim bzhin du bden pa bzhi la 'doms pa dang*/

shā ri'i bu+u gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos yum la spyod pa'i tshe gzugs la zhes sogs dang*/ gzugs dngos por zhes sogs dang*/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di gang nas 'dir skyes pa lags/ zhes sogs kyi go rim bzhin du dkon mchog gsum la 'doms pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lus dang zhes sogs kyis brtson 'grus la 'doms pa dang*/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i sha'i mig ces sogs kyis spyan lnga la dang*/ shā ri'i bu yum la spyod pas pha rol tu phyin pa thob ces sogs kyis mngon shes drug la 'doms pa dang*/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yum las brtsams zhes sogs kyis mthong lam dang*/ rab 'byor 'dus ma byas kyi dbyings med par zhes sogs kyi sgom lam la 'doms pa yin no// dge 'dun dkon mchog bye brag tu bshad pa/ gnyis pa dge 'dun dkon mchog bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis te/ mtshon byed dpe'i dge 'dun/ mtshon bya don gyi dge 'dun no/ /dang po (mtshon byed dpe'i dge 'dun )la gnyis te/ thob byed gang zag /thob bya 'bras bu'o/ /dang po (thob byed gang zag )la gsum ste/ chags bral sngon

song*/ spang bya cig car ba/ 'bras bu rim gyis pa'o/ /dang po( chags bral sngon song )la ni/ phyir 'ong dang phyir mi 'ong gnyis kho na yin te/ de gnyis kyi spang bya'i gtso bo mthong lam gyi snga rol tu 'jig rten pa'i sgom lam gyis spong ba yod pas so/ /rgyun zhugs dang dgra bcom pa gnyis la chags bral sngon song med de/ mthong lam gyi snga rol tu mthong spangs kun sbyor gsum dang*/ srid rtse'i nyon mongs spong mi nus pas so// des na phyir 'ong chags bral sngon song la zhugs gnas gnyis/ dang po (phyir 'ong zhugs pa )ni/ mthong lam gyi snga rol tu 'dod pa'i sgom spangs nyon mongs drug pa nas/ brgyad pa'i bar ci rigs par spangs shing da lta mthong lam skad cig ma bco lnga po gang rung la gnas pa de'o/ /'bras gnas ni/ gang zag des bcu drug pa'i rtogs pa thob pa'i tshe'o/ /de'i tshe mthong lam skad cig ma bco lnga po la gnas pa'i gang zag dbang rtul la dad pa'i rjes 'brang dang*/ dbang rnon la chos kyi rjes 'brang zhes bya zhing*/ bcu drug pa'i rtogs pa thob pa'i tshe gang zag de gnyis la dad mos dang mthong thob ces bya'o/ /de ni 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar ro// gnyis pa chags bral sngon song gi phyir mi 'ong la zhugs gnas gnyis las/ dang po (phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa )ni/ mthong lam gyi snga rol tu 'dod nyon dgu pa nas ci yang med pa'i bar ci rigs pa la chags pa dang bral zhing da lta mthong lam skad cig ma bco lnga po gang rung la gnas pa de'o/ /gnyis pa (phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas )ni/ bcu drug pa'i rtogs pa thob pa'i tshe'o/ /gnyis pa (spang bya cig car ba) ni/ rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu la gnas pa'i gang zag gis bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs zag med la brten nas 'dod pa'i nyon mongs pa rnams dang po nas/ dgu pa spong ba'i tshe sa gong ma rnams la yang de ltar du 'gyur la/ dgu pa spangs pa'i rnam grol lam thob pa na dgra bcom 'bras gnas su 'gyur ba yin no/

/de la 'bras bu bar pa gnyis ni mi 'byung ste/ de gnyis 'dod nyon gyi spangs pa kho na las bzhag pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa ('bras bu rim gyis pa )la/ rgyun zhugs zhugs gnas/ phyir 'ong zhugs gnas/ phyir mi 'ong zhugs gnas/ dgra bcom zhugs gnas dang bzhi'o/ /dang po (rgyun zhugs )la zhugs pa ni/ mthong lam gyi snga rol tu sgom spangs cung zad kyang ma spangs pa'am/ lam zag bcas kyi 'dod nyon lnga pa man chad spangs na yang rung*/ mthong lam skad cig ma bco lnga po gang rung la gnas pa'o/ /'bras gnas ni/ des tshe de la bcu drug pa'i rtogs pa thob pa ste/ de la yang*/ sgom spangs cung zad kyang ma spangs pa 'dod par skye ba bdun len pa dang*/ lam zag med kyi 'dod pa'i sgom spangs gsum pa dang bzhi pa spangs pas 'dod par rigs mthun gyi skye ba gnyis sam gsum len pa ste gnyis yod do// gnyis pa (phyir 'ong )la zhugs pa ni/ mthong lam la zhugs pa ni/ mthong lam thob rjes su 'dod pa'i sgom spangs lnga pa spangs shing drug pa spong ba la brtson pa'o/ /'bras gnas la drug pa spangs pa'i rnam grol lam la gnas pa tsam po ba dang*/ bdun brgyad gnyis spangs pa'i tshe gcig pa bar chad gcig pa ste gnyis yod do// gsum pa (phyir mi 'ong )la zhugs pa ni/ phyir 'ong tshe gcig bar chad gcig pa de nyid yin no/ /'bras gnas la 'dod nyon dgu pa las grol ba'i phyir mi 'ong tsam po ba dang*/ khyad par can ni bsam gtan dang po nas srid nyon brgyad pa la chags pa dang bral ba'i bar gyi 'phags pa thams cad do// de la dbye na/ gzugs su nyer 'gro/ /gzugs med nyer 'gro/ mthong chos zhi/ 'dod par tshe yongs gyur/ lus mngon byed dang lnga yod pa las/ dang po (gzugs su nyer 'gro )la/ bar 'da' ba/ skyes 'da' ba/ mngon par 'du byed pa dang bcas te 'da' ba/ mngon par 'du byed med par 'da' ba/ gong 'pho dang lnga'o/ /dang po (bar 'da' ba )ni/

'dod pa'i rten can gyi phyir mi 'ong zhig gis gzugs khams su skye ba'i kun sbyor spangs shing mngon par 'grub pa'i kun sbyor ma spangs pas gzugs khams su+u skyes pa'i bar dor mya ngan las 'das pa de'o/ /gnyis pa (skyes 'da' ba )ni/ gang zag des skye ba'i kun sbyor yang ma spangs pas skyes ma thag tu mya ngan las 'da' ba'o/ /gsum pa (mngon par 'du byed pa dang bcas te 'da' ba )ni/ gang zag des 'bad rtsol gyi 'du byed dang bcas nas gzugs khams kyi tshe'i dkyil tsam du 'da' ba'o/ /bzhi pa (mngon par 'du byed med par 'da' ba )ni/ 'du byed med par tshe'i mjug tu 'da' ba'o/ /lnga pa (gong 'pho )ni/ rang gang du skyes pa der mya ngan las 'da' ma nus pas sa gong mar 'phos te 'gro ba'o/ /gong 'pho 'di la lhag mthong shas che zhing bsam gtan gyi spel sgom thob pa 'og min 'gro dang*/ zhi gnas shas cher spyod pa spel sgom ma thob pa srid rtser 'gro gnyis su yod cing*/ 'og min 'gro la yang 'dod pa'i rten can gyi phyir mi 'ong ba bsam gtan gong ma gsum las nyams pa des skye ba phyi ma tshangs ris su skyes/ rten de las bsam gtan gyi spel sgom ches shin tu chen po sor chud de/ skye ba phyi ma 'og min du skyes nas myang 'das thob pa'i 'phar ba dang*/ des spel sgom dang po gsum po gang rung sor chud/ skye ba phyi ma gnas gtsang ma'i 'og min du skyes nas myang 'das thob pa'i 'phar ba dang*/ des spel sgom dang po gsum po gang rung sor chud/ skye ba phyi ma gnas gtsang ma'i 'og ma gsum po gang rung du skyes/ rten de las spel sgom ches shin tu chen po sor chud par byas/ de'i skye ba phyi ma 'og min du mya ngan las 'da' ba'i phyed du 'phar ba dang*/ des spel sgom ches shin tu chen po ma thob pas tshangs ris ma gtogs pa'i gzugs kyi gnas rnams su 'chi 'pho zhing*/ mthar 'og min du myang 'das mngon du byed pa'i gnas thams cad du 'chi 'pho ba dang gsum yod do//

bsam gtan spel mar sgom tshul ni/ bsam gtan bzhi ka la spel sgom yod kyang*/ dang por bzhi pa nyid spel bar byed pa yin te/ de lam sla ba rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /spel tshul ni/ chung ngu gsum spel/ 'bring drug spel/ chen po dgu spel/ shin tu chen po bcu gnyis spel/ ches shin tu chen po bco lnga spel dang lnga yod pa las/ dang po la mtshon na/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i snyoms 'jug zag med la rgyun ldan du snyoms par 'jug de nas zag bcas la/ slar zag med la 'jug pa gsum dang*/ yang de gsum skad cig ma gnyis gnyis su 'jug pa ni sbyor ba'o/ /dngos gzhi ni/ skad cig ma re re kho na la zag bcas zag med gsum spel bar nus pa ste/ spel sgom grub pa'i tshad yin no// slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ skad cig ma re re bsre nus pa de ni ston pa sangs rgyas kho nas yin gyi/ gzhan pas ni/ ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin rgyun ldan du 'jug nus pa nyid kyi grub pa yin zhes gsungs so/ /spel sgom gang gi phyir byed na/ phyir mi 'ong dbang rnon gyis ni bder gnas dang gnas gtsang mar skye ba'i phyir dang*/ dgra bcom dbang rnon gyis ni bder gnas ky-i phyir dang*/ de gnyis dbang rtul gyis ni 'bras bu las mi nyams pa'i phyir 'jug pa yin no/ /phyi ma srid rtser 'gro ni/ gnas gtsang ma ma gtogs pa'i gzugs dang gzugs med kyi gnas rnams su 'chi 'pho zhing mthar srid rtse'i rten las myang 'das thob pa'o// gnyis pa gzugs med nyer 'gro ni/ gzugs la 'dod chags dang bral bas skye ba phyi ma gzugs khams su mi 'gro bar gzugs med du 'gro ba ste dbye na bar 'da' ba ma gtogs pa'i 'da' ba gsum gong 'pho dang bzhi yod do// gsum pa (mthong chos zhi )ni/ bden pa mthong ba'i tshe de nyidal myang 'das mngon du byed pa ste/ mchog zung gcig lta bu'o// bzhi pa ('dod par tshe yongs gyur )ni/

'phags pa'i skye ba brgyud mar len pa ste/ de la khams gsum ga'i rten can yod cing*/ 'dod par tshe yongs gyur ni khams gzhan du mi 'gro'o/ /lnga pa (lus mngon byed )ni/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug thob la ma nyams pa'i phyir mi 'ong ste lus la rnam shes 'gags pas so/ /bzhi pa (dgra bcom )la zhugs pa ni/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyon mongs dang po spong ba nas srid nyon dgu pa spong ba'i bar chad med lam la gnas pa'i bar thams cad yin la/ de spong ba'i bar chad med lam la rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /'bras gnas ni srid nyon dgu pa zad pa'i so sor brtags 'gog thob pa dang dus mnyam du rnam grol lam zad pa shes pa'i ye shes skye ba yin no/ /gal te mi g.yo ba'i rigs can yin na ni mi skye ba shes pa'i ye shes kyang skye'o// spyir dgra bcom la ni/ yongs su nyams pa'i chos can/ bdag gsod pa'i chos can/ rjes su bsrung ba'i chos can/ gnas pa la mi skyod pa'i chos can/ rtogs pa'i skal ba can/ mi g.yo ba'i chos can dang drug tu yod/ /rigs de dag mi slob par ma zad slob pa la yang yod do// gnyis pa thob bya 'bras bu la gsum ste/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ thob tshul lo/ /dang po (ngo bo )ni/ zag med bar chad med lam de la ni dge sbyong gi tshul zhes bya zhing de'i stobs kyis sgrib pa las grol ba la ni dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu zhes bya'o/ /'o na 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis spangs pas phye ba'i 'bras bu bar pa gnyis dge sbyong tshul 'bras su mi rung ste/ lam zag med kyi 'bras bu ma yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ skyon med de/ 'bras bu de gnyis byis pa'i sgom lam gyis thob pa'i tshe/ mthong spangs dang sgom spangs spangs pa'i spangs pa gnyis bsres pa dang*/ zag med kyi thob pa 'dus byas dang ldan pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa (dbye ba )ni/ 'dus byas rnam grol lam dang*/ 'dus ma byas so sor brtags 'gog gnyis su phye ba dang*/

rgyas par phye na de re re la brgyad cu rtsa dgu rtsa dgu yod de/ mthong spangs brgyad dang*/ zag med sgom spangs brgyad cu rtsa gcig las grol ba dang zad pa'o/ /de dag kyang 'bras bu srid tshad kyi dbang du byas kyi/ rgyu lnga tshang ba'i dge sbyong tshul 'bras la ni rgyun zhugs sogs bzhir nges so// gsum pa (thob tshul )ni/ dge sbyong tshul 'bras bzhi po de dag lam gang gis thob ce na/ 'bras bu thog mtha' gnyis ni 'das lam kho nas thob ste/ sgom lam gyis mthong spangs dang byis pa'i sgom lam gyis srid nyon spong mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /'bras bu bar pa gnyis kyang mthong lam gyis thob pa'i tshe 'das lam dang*/ sgom lam gyis thob pa na gnyis kas thob pa yin no/ de yang 'bras bu dang po ni mthong lam dang*/ bar pa gnyis rim gyis pa yin na sgom lam dang*/ chags bral sngon song yin na mthong lam gyis thob/ dgra bcom ni sgom lam gyis thob bo/ /'das lam gyis thob pa'i 'bras bu las nyams pa med cing*/ zag bcas kyis thob pa ni nyams pa srid do// yang 'bras bu de dag gi sems rten ni/ dang po gnyis bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs dang*/ phyir mi 'ong ni bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi bzhi po gang rung gis thob kyi/ gzugs med la ni mi brten te/ de ni 'dod pa las ring ba bzhis ring bas gnyen por mi rung ngo*/ /dgra bcom ni zag med sa dgu gang rung la brten nas thob bo// lus rten ni/ 'bras bu dang po gsum 'dod rten dang*/ bzhi pa ni khams gsum ga'i rten can yod do// gnyis pa mtshon bya don gyi dge 'dun la gsum ste/ 'jog mtshams/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams so/ /dang po ('jog mtshams )ni/ 'di skabs kyi dge 'dun nyi shu ni/ byang sems slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs kho na la/ lus rten skye ba len tshul sogs cha 'ga' zhig 'dra ba'i sgo nas nyan rang dge 'dun gyi ming gis bstan pa rnams yin cing*/

de yang spang bya shes sgrib rtog pa spong tshul gyi cha nas 'jog pa yin gyi/ gzhan du na byang 'phags kyis sa brgyad pa man chad du nyon sgrib ma lus pa spangs zin pa dang*/ theg dman dgra bcom gyi rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i byang 'phags kyang grangs nges nyi shu po 'dir 'dus shing 'jog dgos pas so// gnyis pa (dbye ba )ni/ dbang po rtul dang rnon po dag/ dad dang mthong thob rigs nas rigs// bar chad gcig par skyes nas dang*// byed dang byed min 'og min 'gro// 'phar gsum srid rtse mthar thug 'gro// gzugs kyi chags bcom mthong ba yi// chos la zhi lus mngon sum byed// theg chen 'phags lam la gnas pa'i byang sems dge 'dun mdo las zhe lnga dang nyer lnga sogs gsungs pa rje btsun gyis nyi shur bsdus pa'i dbye ba la gnyis te/ nyan thos kyi ming can/ rang rgyal gyi ming can no// dang po (nyan thos kyi ming can )la/ rgyun zhugs kyi skor/ phyir 'ong gi skor/ phyir mi 'ong gi skor/ dgra bcom gyi skor ro/ /dang po (rgyun zhugs )la/ zhugs gnas gnyis/ dang po (zhugs pa )ni/ theg chen mthong lam skad cig ma dang po bco lnga po gang rung la gnas pa dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i dbang po rtul po dang*/ chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i dbang po rnon po dag ste/ rgyun zhugs zhugs pa gnyis/ mdo ni/ shā ri'i bu byang chen gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnal 'byor 'di la snyoms par zhugs pa de ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas shi 'phos nas zhes sogs so// gnyis pa ('bras gnas )la gnyis te/ tsam po ba dang*/ khyad par can no/ /dang po (tsam po ba )ni/ bcu drug pa lam rjes shes la gnas pa'i rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas tsam po ba dang gsum/ gnyis pa (khyad par can )ni/ des 'dod pa'i sgom spangs shes sgrib gsum mam bzhi pa spangs nas bsam bzhin du 'dod lha'i skye ba gnyis sam/ mi'i skye ba gnyis len pa rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas rigs nas rigs skye dang bzhi/

shā ri'i bu byang chen zhes pa nas/ rgyal rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'am/ bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'am/ khyim bdag gi rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu rnams su skye ba'ang yodado/ /zhes dang*/ yang shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' nas/ rgyal po chen po bzhi'i rigs kyi lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye/ zhes pa nas/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye ste zhes sogs so// phyi 'ong skor la gsum ste/ zhugs pa/ 'bras tsam/ 'bras gnas khyad par can no/ /dang po (zhugs pa )ni/ 'dod pa'i sas bsdus kyi sgom spangs shes sgrib lnga pa spangs nas/ drug pa spong bzhin pa'i dad pas mos pa dang*/ mthong bas thob pa gang rung gcig tu byas pa'i lnga/ shā ri'i bu byang chen thabs la mi mkhas pa gang zhes pa nas/ de dag gi dbang po rnams rtul por 'gyur zhing rnon por mi 'gyur ba dag kyang yod do/ /ces so// gnyis pa ('bras tsam )ni/ de spangs nas rnam grol lam thob ma thag pa'i phyir 'ong 'bras gnas tsam po dang drug gsum pa ('bras gnas khyad par can )ni/ bsam bzhin du 'dod par skye ba gcig len cing 'dod pa'i sgom spangs shes sgrib bdun brgyad spangs shing*/ dgu pa spong ba la zhugs pa'i phyir 'ong 'bras gnas tshe gcig bar chad gcig pa dang bdun/ shā ri'i bu byang chen bsam gtan bzhi thob pa nas sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad thob pa dang zhes pa nas/ byang chub sems dpa' de ni tshe gcig gi thogs par shes par bya'o/ /zhes so//

phyir mi 'ong skor la/ zhugs gnas gnyis/ dang po (zhugs pa )ni/ 'dod pa'i shes sgrib dgu pa spong bzhin pa'i dbang po rno rtul gcig tu bgrangs pa'i phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa dang brgyad/ mdo ni/ sngar phyir 'ong zhugs pa bzhin/ gnyis pa ('bras gnas )ni/ 'dod pa'i sgom spangs shes sgrib dgu pa spangs ma thag gzugs khams su skye ba'i bar dor mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston pa'i bar 'da' ba dang dgu/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bya ba nas/ tshangs ris kyi lha rnams nas 'og min gyi lha rnams kyi bar du skye bar 'gyur zhing der bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas zhes gsungs so// des gzugs khams su skyes nas tshe stod la 'da' ba skye 'da' ba dang bcu/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang dag dang po sems bskyed pa nyid kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ces sogs so/ /gzhan snga ma bzhin la tshe mjug tu 'bad rtsol chen pos mngon par 'du byed dang bcas te 'da' ba dang bcu gcig shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod pa gang dag ces pa nas/ nam yang don med pa'i tshig mi smra'o/ /zhes so/ /sngar bzhin la tshe'i dkyil du mngon par 'du byed kyi rtsol ba chen po min pas 'da' ba dang bcu gnyis/ shā ri'i bu byang chen gang dag dang po sems bskyed pa nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' skyon med pa las 'das shing phyir mi bzlog pa'i sa la yang nges par gnas nas sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyang skrun par byed pa yod do/ /zhes so/ /byang sems phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas bsam gtan gyi spel sgom thob nas 'og min du 'gro ba la dbye na/ 'dod pa'i sgom spangs shes sgrib dgu pa spangs shing gzugs khams kyi sgom spangs shes sgrib spong bzhin pa skye ba phyi ma tshangs ris dang de'i phyi ma 'og min du skyes nas rten de las 'da' tshul ston pa phyir mi 'ong 'phar ba gcig dang bcu gsum/

shā ri'i bu byang chen gang dag bsam gtan bzhi bsgrubs te yongs su nyams nas bsam gtan dang po bsgrubs te tshangs ris kyi lha rnams kyi nang du skyes shing de de dag la bsam gtan rnams bsgrubs nas 'og min du skyes nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs pa rnams su bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dag yod do/ /zhes so/ /gzhan sngar bzhin la/ phyi ma tshangs ris dang de'i phyi ma gnas gtsang ma 'og ma gsum gang rung dang*/ de'i phyi ma 'og min du skyes nas 'da' tshul ston pa'i phyed du 'phar ba dang gnyis te bcu bzhi/ shā ri'i bu byang chen gang dag tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas shi 'phos nas gnas gtsang mar skyes te/ gnas gtsang ma'i gnas gcig gam gnyis brgal nas 'og min du skyes te sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs pa rnams su bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya ba dag yod do/ /zhes so/ /gzhan sngar bzhin la/ skye ba phyi ma gzugs khams gnas rigs rnams la rim pas skye ba blangs nas 'og min kyi rten la 'da' tshul ston pa gnas thams cad du 'chi 'pho dang gsum ste bco lnga/ shā ri'i bu byang chen gang dag bdag nyid lus de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku lta bur sprul nas dga' ldan gyi gnas su yongs su sbyangs te tshangs ris kyi lha nas 'og min gyi lha'i bar du skyes te thabs la mkhas pas sems can dmyal ba pa rnams la chos ston cing*/ zhes pa nas/ mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dag yod do/ /zhes so/ /phyir mi 'ong de nyidal srid rtse'i mthar thug 'gro ba ste gzugs kyi khams la chags pa bcom pa dang bcu drug shā ri'i bu byang chen bsam gtan dang gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa thob par gyur pa gang yin pa de dag nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched nas srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du skye bar byed do/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs su skye bar 'gyur ba dag yod do/

/zhes so/ /bden pa mthong ba'i tshe de nyid du chos la zhi ba thob pa dang bcu bdun/ shā ri'i bu byang chen gang dag pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod pa'i tshe lus la skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan cing dbang po yongs su dag la bla na med pa dang ldan pa zhes sogs so/ /'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug lus kyis mngon sum du byed pa lus mngon byed dang bco brgyad/ shā ri'i bu byang chen shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa gang dag bsam gtan bzhi thob pa dang*/ zhes bya ba nas/ bsam gtan dang po la snyoms par 'jug go /de las langs nas 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la snyoms par 'jug go /de las langs nas bsam gtan gnyis pa la snyoms par 'jug go /zhes so// bzhi pa dgra bcom gyi skor ni/ srid rtse'i sgom spangs shes sgrib dgu pa spong bzhin pa'i dgra bcom zhugs pa dang bcu dgu/ /sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi chos snang bar byed cing bdag nyid bla na med par byang chub ces sogs so// gnyis pa rang rgyal gyi ming can ni/ bse ru dang ni nyi shu'o// sangs rgyas dang nyan thos med pa'i zhing du myang 'das mngon du byed cing sgra med lus kyi rnam 'gyur gyi sgo nas chos ston pa'i byang 'phags rang rgyal bse ru lta bu dang ni nyi shu'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang dag sangs rgyas mi bzhugs shing nyan thos rnams kyang med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dag kyang yod do/ /zhes so/ de ltar nyi shu'i grangs 'dren tshul 'di ni slob dpon seng ge bzang po'i dgongs pa sor bzhag go /gzhan grangs 'dren tshul la bzhed pa mi 'dra ba mang yang ma bris so// gsum pa sa mtshams ni/ dang po gnyis sa dang po la/ rigs gnas rigs skyes gnyis sa gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi pa lnga pa rnams la/ phyir 'ong 'bras zhugs sa drug pa la/

tshe gcig bar chad gcig pa sa bdun pa la/ phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa sa brgyad pa dang dgu pa la/ phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas thams cad sa bcu pa la/ dgra bcom zhugs pa dang bse ru lta bu sa bcu pa'i bar chad med lam la bzhag ste/ de dag ni 'phags pa'i dgongs pa a bha yas bshad pa ltar ro/ /ci byang sems rnams spang bya cig car spong ba yin pa la 'di skabs rim gyis par phye snyam na/ byang sems dbang po shin tu rtul ba'i rigs can 'ga' zhig khams gsum gyi shes sgrib rim gyis spong ba'am/ yang na gdul bya'i dbang gis nyan thos kyi rnam bzhag dang bstun pas skyon med do// nges 'byed yan lag bzhi/ gnyis pa de bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu+u nges 'byed 'chad pa la gnyis te/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung don no/ /dang po la gsum ste/ rten/ ngo bo/ blo rigs dpyad pa'o/ /dang po (rten )la/ lus rten mthong lam skye ba'i rten dang mtshungs so/ /sems rten theg dman ltar na bsam gtan sa drug po kho na la brten/ /theg chen lugs la byang sems ni thabs mkhas pas 'dod sems la brten nas kyang sbyor lam yongs rdzogs skye ba yod do// gnyis pa (ngo bo )la gsum ste/ mtshan nyid/ mtshon bya/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po (mtshan nyid )ni/ sgom byung gang zhig mthong lam ma skyes gong gi bden pa mngon rtogs so/ /gnyis pa (mtshon bya )ni/ 'phags lam la dngos su sbyor zhing rgyur gyur pa'o/ /gsum pa (dbye ba )la/ gnas skabs kyi sgo nas phye na/ mthong lam skye ba la tshe rabs kyi dus nges pa med pa nges 'byed yan lag chung ngu*/ dus nges pa tsam 'bring po/ tshe de nyid la mthong lam skye bar nges pa chen po dang gsum/ ngo bo'i sgo nas phye na/ drod rtse bzod pa chos mchog dang bzhi/ de dag so so'i ngos 'dzin la/ drod ni/ tshogs lam du thos bsam gyis sbyangs pa'i mthus shes pa las tha dad pa'i gzung ba rang bzhin med pa la shes rab kyi snang ba cung zad thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/

/rtse mo ni/ chos kyi snang ba 'phel ba'i ched du brtson pas gzung ba med pa la gsal snang khyad par du gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /bzod pa ni/ gzung med rtog pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba brtan zhing gang zag rdzas yod kyi 'dzin pa rang bzhin med pa la gsal snang skye ba'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /chos mchog ni/ brtags pa'i chos kyi 'dzin pa rang bzhin med pa la gsal snang skye ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de dag re re la'ang dmigs rnam gyi khyad par gyi chung 'bring chen po gsum gsum du yod do// de ltar sbyor lam bzhir dbye ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ chos nyid kyi don cung zad rtogs pa'i khyad par la mi 'dra ba bzhis ngos skal gyi spang bya rnam rtog bzhi po mngon gyur tsam spong bar byed pa'i sgo nas dbye ba yin no// sbyor lam gyi stong tshul ni/ mdzod las/ 'phags pas de dag sa bor bas// stong ngo 'phags min shi bas so// dang po gnyis yongs nyams pas kyang*// zhes bshad pa ltar ro// gsum pa (blo rigs dpyad pa )ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ yang dag min rtog yang dag min// rtog min mi rtog ma yin pa// shes bya thams cad yin par brjod// ces gsungs pa ltar/ rtog pa ma yin pa'i chos nyid cung zad rtogs pa'i 'jig rten pa'i ye shes zhig go/ gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dmigs pa dang ni rnam pa dang*// rgyu dang yongs su 'dzin pa yis// byang chub sems dpa' skyob pa yi// drod sogs bdag nyid ji bzhin du// rnam rtog bzhi po ldan bsten pa// chung dang 'bring dang chen po rnams// nyan thos bse ru lta bu dang*// bcas pa dag las khyad par 'phags// theg pa chen po'i gdams ngag thob pa'i rjes su/ de'i don dmigs pa drug dang yid la byed pa bcu gcig dang sems gnas pa'i thabs dgus legs par bsgoms pas theg pa 'og ma'i sbyor lam las khyad chos lngas khyad par du 'phags pa'i nges 'byed yan lag 'byung bas de bshad pa/

dmigs pa'i yul bden pa bzhi sgyu ma lta bu dang ni/ de dag la mngon zhen med pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa can dang*/ theg pa gsum char gyi rtogs rigs tshang ba'i mthong lam rtogs pa'i rgyu byed pa dang*/ phyi nang gi yongs su 'dzin pas zin pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba skyob pa'i mdzad pa can gyi drod la sogs pa 'dis ni bdag nyid kyi dbye ba ji lta ba bzhin du theg chen mthong lam gyi spang byar gyur pa'i gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog bzhi po dang mtshungs ldan du byas pa'i mngon gyur ba spong ba'i tshul gyis bsten pa ste/ de ltar rnam pa lngas chung dang 'bring dang chen po'i dbye ba bcu gnyis rnams dang ldan pa'i sbyor lam 'di ni nyan thos dang bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal dang bcas pa'i sbyor lam dag las khyad par du 'phags so// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gsum ste/ dmigs rnam rgyu gsum bshad/ ldan chos rtog pa bshad/ bdag rkyen yongs 'dzin bshad pa'o/ /dang po (dmigs rnam rgyu gsum bshad pa )la gnyis te/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung don no/ /dang po ni/ bye brag tu smra bas dmigs pa ni gzugs lta bu+u yul gyi spyi dang*/ rnam pa ni sngon po lta bu yul gyi khyad par la 'dod/ /mdo sde pas rnam pa gtod byed kyi rgyu la dmigs pa dang der snang ba ni rnam par 'dod/ /sems tsam pas gzung cha la dmigs pa dang 'dzin cha la rnam par 'dod do//'dir dmigs pa ni yul yin cing*/ rnam pa ni blos yul rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs yin par 'chad dgos so// des na theg dman gyi sbyor lam ni mtshan 'dzin dang bcas nas gang zag gi bdag 'dzin kho na'i gnyen por bskyed de/ de yang drod rtse gnyis bzod pa chung ngu rnams ni 'dod pa dang khams gong gi bden pa bzhi la dmigs nas mi rtag sogs rnam pa bcu drug bcu drug ste sum cu rtsa gnyis re tshang bar bsgom zhing*/ bzod pa 'bring gi gnas skabs su ni rnam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis las dang por khams gong gi lam bden gyi rnam pa bzhi bor nas nyi shu rtsa brgyad/

de nas 'dod pa'i bzhi bor nas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ tshul de nyid kyis bden pa gzhan rnams la'ang phri bas/ nyi shu/ bcu drug /bcu gnyis/ brgyad dang*/ mthar 'dod pa'i sdug bden gyi rnam pa bzhi/ de nas kyang de'i rnam pa gcig lan gnyis su sgom pa'i bar te/ skad cig ma brgyad cu rtsa dgu yin no/ /bzod pa chen po ni rnam pa de nyid lan gcig yid la byed pa skad cig gcig go /chos mchog kyang dmigs rnam de bzhin skad cig gcig yin no/ /de lta'i sbyor lam gyi ngo bo yang bsam gtan la brten pa'i shes rab ste/ rjes 'brang rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs kyang yod pas 'khor bcas phung po lnga par 'dod do// gnyis pa gzhung gi don la bzhi ste/ bden bzhi la dmigs te kun nas nyon mongs kyi gzung ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa drod/ 'bras bu rnam byang gi gzung ba rang bzhin med rtogs rtse mo/ gang zag rdzas yod kyi 'dzin pa rang bzhin med rtogs bzod pa/ skyes bu btags yod kyi 'dzin pa rang bzhin med rtogs chos mchog ste/ bzhi po re re'i dmigs rnam bshad pa'o// dang po (drod )la/ drod chung ngu'i dmigs pa ni/ dmigs pa mi rtag la sogs pa// bden pa'i rten can de yi ni// mi rtag pa la sogs pa'i dbye ba dang ldan pa'i bden pa bzhi'i rten can tsam mo/ /de'i rnam pa ni/ rnam pa mngon zhen la sogs 'gog/ mngon par zhen pa la sogs pa'i spros mtshan 'gog pa ste zhi ba'o/ /mdo ni/ 'di la byang sems chen po yum la spyod pa'i tshe gzugs mi rtag ces bya bar mngon par zhen pa dang zhes so// theg pa gsum car 'thob pa'i rgyu// de lta bu ni theg pa gsum char gyi yon tan tshang ba'i mthong lam thob pa'i rgyu byed pa yin no/ /mdo ni/ theg pa gsum po rnams rgya cher bstan to/ /zhes so// drod 'bring gi dmigs pa ni/ gzugs sogs 'du 'god gzugs la sogs pa'i chos rnams 'du ba ste sgrub pa dang 'god pa ste dgag pas stongs pa de'o/

/gzugs kyi 'du ba dang 'god pa ma 'tshal ma dmigs/ zhes so/ /rnam pa ni/ gnas bral dang*// gnas dang bral ba dang ste ming tsam las gzhan par mi gnas pa'i don no/ /ming de yang gnas pa yang ma lags zhes sogs so// drod chen po'i dmigs pa ni/ gnas dang btags dang gzugs la sogs pa'i chos de dag gi gnas tshul dang*/ der btags pa'i tha snyad dang bcas pa thams cad grub pa med pa'o/ /chos su btags pa tsam du bas so/ /zhes so/ /rnam pa ni/ brjod du med// ming dmigs su med cing dge mi dge sogs su bsdur med pa'i phyir brjod du med pa'o/ /dper na rmi lam zhes bgyi ba'i ming ni gang gis kyang brjod du ma mchis pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de ltar chung 'bring che gsum po de la ni/ mthong lam rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi me 'byung ba'i snga ltas su gyur pa'i phyir dro bar gyur pa zhes bya'o// gnyis pa (rtse mo )la/ rtse mo chung ngu'i dmigs pa ni/ gzugs sogs mi gnas de dag ni// de yi ngo bor rang bzhin med// gzugs la sogs pa don dam par mi gnas pa de dag ni gnas par byar med de don dam par de'i rang gi ngo bo rang bzhin med pa'o/ /yum la spyod pas gzugs la gnas par mi bgyi'o/ /zhes so/ /rnam pa ni/

de dag gcig gi rang bzhin gcig/ de mi rtag sogs par mi gnas// chos can dang chos nyid de dag gcig gi rang bzhin du gcig pa de gzugs sogs stong nyid du gnas/ /stong nyid gzugs sogs su snang ba'i phyir de la mi rtag pa la sogs par zhen pa mi gnas pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gzugs mi rtag pa nyid gzugs mi rtag pa nyid kyis stong ste zhes sogs so// rtse mo 'bring gi dmigs pa ni/ de rnams de yi ngo bos stong*// de dag gcig gi rang bzhin gcig/ mi rtag pa dang stong pa nyid la sogs pa de rnams rang rang de'i ngo bos stong pa'i phyir mi rtag pa la sogs pa de dag stong pa nyid gcig gi rang bzhin du gcig pa'o/ /rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong pa'i chos rnams la chos gang yang yongs su ma bzung ngo*/ /zhes so/ /rnam pa ni/ chos rnams mi 'dzin gang yin dang*// chos rnams kyi ngo bo'am khyad par gang yang mi 'dzin pa gang yin pa dang*/ chos rnams la yongs su mi 'dzin pa dang mi 'dor ba gang lags pa de ni yum lags so// rtse mo chen po'i dmigs pa ni/ de dag mtshan mar mi mthong phyir// chos de dag la mtshan mar mi mthong ba de'i phyir yongs grub kyi ngo bor gsal ba de'o/ /brgyad stong pa las/ gang yongs su mi 'dzin zhes sogs so/ /rnam pa ni/ shes rab kyis ni yongs rtog pa// thams cad dmigs su med par ro// shes rab kyis ni de bzhin nyid la yongs su rtog pa na rnam pa thams cad dmigs su med par rtogs pa'o/ /yum ni gang*/ yum 'di ni gang gi /yum 'di ni ci zhig /ci'i phyir de la yum zhes bya zhes de ltar yongs su brtag par bya'o zhes so/ /de ltar chung 'bring che gsum la ni dge ba'i rtsa ba g.yo ba rgyun chad pa'i rtse mo ste de thob nas dge rtsa chad pa mi srid pas rtse mo zhes bya'o// gsum pa (bzod pa )la/ bzod pa chung ngu'i dmigs pa ni/ gzugs sogs ngo bo nyid med nyid//

gzugs la sogs pa rang gi ngo bo nyid med pa nyid do/ /gzugs ni gzugs kyi rang bzhin dang bral ba'o/ /zhes so/ /rnam pa ni/ de med pa nyid ngo bo nyid// de med pa de nyid gzugs sogs kyi ngo bo nyid du zhen pa'o*/ /gzugs kyi rang bzhin ni dngos po med pa'o/ /zhes so// bzod pa 'bring gi dmigs pa ni/ de dag skye med nges 'byung med// gzugs sogs de dag skye ba 'khor ba'i rang bzhin du med cing skye med nges par 'byung ba myang 'das kyi rang bzhin du'ang med pa'o/ /gzugs ni gzugs kyi rang bzhin gyis stong ste de la skye ba'am nges par 'byung ba yang mi dmigs so/ /zhes so/ /rnam pa ni/ dag dang*/ chos nyid dag pa khong du chub pa'i mthus sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag pa rgyu'i sgo nas dang*/ lus yongs su dag pa dang zhes so// bzod pa chen po'i dmigs pa ni/ de dag mtshan ma med// de bzhin nyid de dag la spros pa'i mtshan ma med par snang ba'o/ /gzugs la spyod na mtshan ma la spyod do/ /zhes so/ /rnam pa ni/ de yi mtshan mar mi bsten pas// mos min 'du shes med pa yin// gzugs sogs de yi mtshan mar mi bsten pas yid la byed pa la mos pa min cing gzung 'dzin gyi 'du shes med pa'i tshul can yin no/ /gzugs la gnas pa med ces so/ /de ltar chung 'bring chen po gsum la ni/ de thob nas rang dbang med par ngan song du mi skye zhing skye ba med pa'i don la bzod pas bzod pa zhes bya'o// bzhi pa (chos mchog )la/ chos mchog chung ngu'i dmigs pa ni/ ting 'dzin gzugs sogs kyi ngo bo rtogs pa'i skye ba med pa dang*/ dpa' bar 'gro ba la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /byang sems rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin ni chos thams cad skye ba med pa zhes bya ste zhes so/ /rnam pa ni/ de yi byed pa nyid// ting nge 'dzin de'i byed po'i mthus myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba nyid de 'bras bu'i sgo nas so/

/ting nge 'dzin de rnam par spyod pa'i byang sems chen po ni myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes so// chos mchog 'bring gi dmigs pa ni/ lung ston pa dang sangs rgyas rnams kyis lung ston pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /byang sems chen po gang ting nge 'dzin de dag gis gnas pa de ni sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis kyang rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan no//rnam pa ni/ rlom pa zad// chos nyid rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog pa na rlom pa zad pa'o/ /bdag ni mnyam par 'jog go /bdag gis mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ /bdag ni mnyam par bzhag par 'gyur ro zhes rlom sems su 'gyur ba med do zhes so// chos mchog chen po'i dmigs pa ni/ gsum po phan tshun ngo bo gcig/ yul sher phyin dang thabs mnyam bzhag dang de skabs kyi gang zag byang sems gsum po phan tshun du ma mthong bar ngo bo gcig pa'o/ /yum nyid kyang ting nge 'dzin no/ /ting nge 'dzin kyang byang chub sems dpa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyid kyang ting nge 'dzin no/ /zhes so/ /rnam pa ni/ ting 'dzin rnam par mi rtog pa// de ltar nges 'byed cha mthun ni// chung dang 'bring dang chen po yin// ting nge 'dzin rnam par mi rtog pa'o/ /chos thams cad med pa'i phyir rtog med de de ltar na ting nge 'dzin de la rtog pa med pa yin no/ /zhes so/ /de ltar chung 'bring che gsum la ni/ rang gi mjug thogs su zad med kyi lam 'dren par nus pa'i phyir 'jig rten pa'i chos rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pas chos mchog ces bya'o/ /rim pa de ltar bden pa bzhi la dmigs pa rnams gong 'phel du gyur pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun bzhi po ni re re la dang po dang bar dang mtha' mar skyes pa'i tshul gyi chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po ni gsum gsum du yod do// gnyis pa ldan chos rtog pa bshad pa la gnyis te/

spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung don no/ /dang po la gnyis te/ spyir rtog pa'i ngos 'dzin/ khyad par gzhung 'dir gsungs pa so so'i don no// dang po (spyir rtog pa'i ngos 'dzin )ni/ myang 'das kyi rigs kun gzhi'i ye shes la sgrib byed do/ /ngo bo gzung 'dzin gnyis snang can gyi shes pa'o/ /de la kun gzhi'i rnam shes/ ma dag gzhan dbang*/ nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i ma rig pa/ sems can/ yang dag min rtog sogs kyi ming dang ldan no/ /gnyid las rmi lam 'byung ba bzhin/ de las gzung 'dzin rags pa 'ga' zhig la nyon yid kyis bdag tu bzung bas chags sogs nyon mongs dang des las sna tshogs bsags pas sdug bsngal myong*/ phra ba 'ga' zhig la rdzas gzhan rdzas gcig sogs su+u zhen pa'i sgra don 'dres par 'dzin pa las 'khor gsum du rtog pa 'byung zhing zhi bar ltung ngo*/ /de ltar dri ma glo bur ba sprin lta bu de rnams kyi de bzhin nyid nam mkha' lta bu la sgrib bo// gnyis pa (khyad par gzhung 'dir gsungs pa so so'i don )la gnyis te/ gzung 'dzin gyi don/ zhen yul gyi sgo nas phye ba'o/ /dang po (gzung 'dzin gyi don )ni/ 'dir gsungs pa rnams ni sgra don 'dzin pa'i rtog pa gtso che ste/ bdag gi gdags gzhi med bzhin snang ba la zhen pa'i bden 'dzin gyi sgo nas bzhag pa'i phyir/ des na 'dir bdag la 'dzin rtog bdag gi ba la gzung rtog tu+u bzhag ste/ bem rig gi gzung 'dzin min no// gnyis pa (zhen yul gyi sgo nas phye ba )ni/ sbyor lam gyi skabs 'dir spang bya ni/ rnam byang dang kun nyon la blang dor dang gang zag tu lta ba'i gzhi phung sogs rdzas btags su zhen pa/ mthong lam gyi spang bya ni/ byang lam dang dman lam la blang dor dang chos su blta ba'i gzhi rnam shes rdzas btags su zhen pa/ sgom spangs ni/ chos kyi gdags gzhi btags pa tsam du zhes pa kho na ste/ de dag so sor 'dzin pa'i blo spong zhing*/

sbyor lam gyi ni mos pa yid byed tsam gyis spong la de kho na yid byed kyis sa bon drungs 'byin pa ni mthong lam nas so// gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gnyis te/ gzung rtog bshad pa/ 'dzin rtog bshad pa'o/ /dang po (gzung rtog bshad pa )la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhi dang de yi gnyen po yis// gzung bar rtog pa rnam pa gnyis// rmongs dang phung sogs bye brag gis// de ni so sor rnam pa dgu// gzung ba'i gzhi kun nas nyon mongs rnam par ma dag pa dang*/ de'i gnyen po rnam par byang ba'i dbye ba yis de dag la dmigs nas yid la byed pa'i gzung bar rtog pa yang rnam pa gnyis/ de'i dang po la rmongs pa ste ma rig pa sogs la dmigs pa dang*/ phyi ma la rnam par byang ba'i phung po la sogs la dmigs pa'i bye brag gis gzung rtog gnyis po de ni so sor rnam pa dgu dgu yod do// gnyis pa (rgyas par bshad pa )la gnyis las/ dang po (kun nyon gzung rtog )ni/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i rten can nam yul can gyi rnam rtog dgu yod de/ yul dgu la dmigs nas 'di dag kun nas nyon mongs yin pas dor bar bya'o snyam du zhen pas so/ /yul dgu ni/ las rgyu 'bras dang de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa ste/ mdo ni/ chos 'di dag ni byis pa so so'i skye bos ji ltar mngon par chags par bya ba de lta bu'i rnam par yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes so/ /des kun nas bslangs pa'i las kyis bskyed pa'i gzugs phung sogs te/ gzugs nang stong pa nyid kyi phyir yod pa ma yin no/ zhes so//de dag la bdag dang bdag gi bar zhen pa ste/ med pa'i chos la de dag btags nas ming dang gzugs la mngon par zhen/ zhes so/ /de yang rtag chad gang rung du lta ba ste/ med pa'i mtha' gnyis dag tu rtog par byed do/ /zhes so/ de'i mthus kun nyon dang rnam byang gi skyon yon mi shes pa ste/

gzugs kun nas nyon mongs pa'o zhes mi shes mi mthong ngo*/ /zhes so/ /de ma shes pas 'phags pa'i lam la mi gnas pa ste sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa ma yin no/ /zhes so/ /de ltar lam gol bas chos rnams phyin ci log tu dmigs pa ste/ rnam mkhyen nyid du mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis 'byung ba yin no/ /zhes so/ /bdag gi cha la chags pa dang gzhan gyi cha la sdang ba ste shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir bdag mi dmigs zhes so/ /rnam par dag pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos bskyed pa'i rgyu dang la sogs pas zag bcas kyi dge ba'i las te/ /rnam par dag pa ni skye ba med pa ma byung ba mngon par 'du byed pa med pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de ltar phye ba'i dang po ni ma rig pa/ gsum pa ni 'jig lta/ bzhi pa ni mthar lta yin pas nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung ngo*/ /gnyis pa ni skye ba'i kun 'byung yin pas nyon mongs kyi ngo bo/ lhag ma ni kun nas nyon mongs kyi nyes dmigs dang ngo bo ci rigs pa'o// gnyis pa (rnam byang gzung rtog )ni/ rnam par byang ba yul can gyi gzung rtog dgu yod de/ yul dgu la dmigs nas 'di dag rnam byang yin pas blang bya'o snyam du zhen pas so/ /yul dgu ni/ rnam byang du gyur pa'i phung po ste/ mdo ni/ thabs mi mkhas pas gzugs la rtog cing mngon par zhen pa yin/ zhes so/ /rnam byang gi skye sgo skye mched de/ mig la rtog ces sogs so/ /rnam byang gi rgyu rigs te/ mig dang gzugs dang mig gi rnam par shes pa'i khams su rtog ces so/ /rnam byang gi rten 'brel skye ba lugs 'byung ste/ ma rig pa rtog cing zhes so/ /spros pa dang bral ba'i stong nyid de/ nang stong pa nyid nas dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar la rtog ces so/ /stong nyid med tsam don gnyis phun tshogs kyi rgyur mi rung bas de'i rgyu phar phyin drug ste/ phyin drug la rtog ces so/

/shes bzod bcu drug gi bdag nyid mthong lam ste/ byang chub phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la rtog ces so/ /bsam gzugs kyi ngo bo sgom lam ste/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la rtog ces so//bslab pa yongs su rdzogs pas mi slob pa'i lam ste/ rnam mkhyen nyid kyi bar la rtog ces so/ /de dag ni rnam byang gi dngos po dang rkyen dang rgyu dang rten 'brel dang*/ dmigs pa dang spyod pa dang dbye ba ste/ dang po drug dang mtha' ma gsum rim bzhin no// gnyis pa 'dzin rtog la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rdzas dang btags pa'i rten can gyis// 'dzin pa'ang rnam pa gnyis su 'dod// rang dbang bdag sogs ngo bo dang*// phung sogs rten las de bzhin no// 'dzin yul gang zag gi gdags gzhi la rdzas su grub pa dang*/ btags yod du 'dzin pa'i gnyis yod pas/ de la brten nas yid la byed pa can gyi 'dzin pa'i rtog pa'ang rnam pa gnyis su 'dod/ /de'i dang po la rang dbang can gyi bdag tu 'dzin pa sogs kyi ngo bo can dang*/ phyi ma la phung po la sogs pa'i rten can gyi dbye ba las gzung rtog de bzhin du 'dir yang dgu dgu yod do// gnyis pa (rgyas par bshad pa )la gnyis las/ dang po (rdzas 'dzin rtog pa )ni/ gang zag gi gdags gzhi'i chos rdzas su yod pa'i yul can gyi rtog pa dgu yod de/ chos tsam du gyur pa'i rdzas la dmigs nas zhen pa'i yul dgu yod pas so/ /dgu ni/ bdag de yul 'dzin pa po gzhan la ma ltos par rang dbang can du 'dzin pa ste/ mdo ni/ bdag nye bar mi dmigs zhes pa nas mthong ba po mi dmigs zhes so/ /de zla bo med par gcig por 'dzin pa ste/ gzugs nye bar mi dmigs zhes so/ /de rnam shes kyi rgyur 'dzin pa ste/ mig mi dmigs so zhes so/ /de lta ba po dang shes pa por 'dzin pa ste/ mig dang gzugs dang mig gi rnam par shes pa mi dmigs/

zhes so/ /de kun nas nyon mongs pa'i rten tu 'dzin pa ste/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba mi dmigs zhes so/ /de 'og sa la 'dod chags dang bral byed 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi rten du 'dzin pa ste/ bsam gtan dang po mi dmigs zhes so/ /de mthong ba'i lam gyi rten du 'dzin pa ste/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams mi dmigs zhes so/ /de zag med sgom lam gyi rten du 'dzin pa ste/ rnam par thar pa brgyad dang mthar gyi gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu mi dmigs zhes so/ de rang gzhan gyi don byas zin pa mi slob lam gyi rten du 'dzin pa ste/ stobs bcu mi dmigs zhes so/ /de ltar phye ba'i dang po bzhi phung khams skye mched la 'khrul nas bdag gi mtshan nyid du rtog pa yin/ lhag ma ni bdag dang 'brel bar rtog pa yin no// gnyis pa (btags 'dzin rtog pa )ni/ skyes bu'i gdags gzhi gtags pa yod pa'i yul can gyi rtog pa dgu yod de/ yul dgu la dmigs nas btags pa tsam du zhen pas so/ /yul dgu ni/ gzugs sogs kyi phung po btags pa tsam du 'dzin pa ste/ mdo ni/ rab 'byor gzugs kyang gzhan la sgyu ma'ang gzhan zhig yin snyam mam zhes so// gtags pa tsam du 'dzin zhes pa phyi ma rnams la'ang sbyar ro/ /mig sogs skye mched de mig kyang gzhan zhes so/ /khams bco brgyad de/ mig dang gzugs dang mig gi rnam shes kyang gzhan zhes so/ /ma rig pa sogs rten 'brel bcu gnyis te/ sgyu ma'ang gzhan la rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'ang gzhan zhes so/ /dad sogs rnam par byang ba'i chos sum cu rtsa bdun te/ byang chub phyogs kyi chos rnams kyang gzhan zhes so/ /mthong lam ste/ stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang smon pa med pa yang gzhan zhes so/ /sgom pa'i lam ste/ bsam gtan nam gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'ang gzhan zhes so/ /theg dman las phul du byung ba'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i khyad par gyi lam ste/

sgyu ma'ang gzhan la stong pa nyid thams cad kyang gzhan zhes so/ /mi slob pa'i lam ste/ byang chub kyang gzhan zhes so/ /de ltar phye ba'i dang po bzhi las kyi sgyu ma dang*/ lhag ma rnams ye shes kyi sgyu mas bskyed pa'i btags pa tsam mo//

gsum pa bdag rkyen yongs 'dzin bshad pa ni/ sems mi 'gong ba nyid la sogs// ngo bo nyid med sogs ston byed// de yi mi mthun phyogs bor ba// rnam pa kun tu yongs 'dzin yin// dmigs rnam rgyu gsum ldan chos rtog pas khyad par du byas pa'i sbyor lam skye ba yang yongs su 'dzin pa la rag las pas/ khyad par gsum ldan gyi yongs 'dzin dge bshes nyid bshad cing*/ gsum las thabs mkhas pa'i khyad par ni/ rang nyid rnam mkhyen yid byed dang ma bral bas gdul bya gzhan dag zab mo stong pa nyid kyi don la sems mi 'gong ba nyid dang*/ la sogs pas mi skrag pa dang kun tu mi skrag par byed pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'o/ /mdo ni/ byang sems de ltar yum la spyod pa ni/ sngangs par mi 'gyur skrag par mi 'gyur kun tu skrag pa dang ldan par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /chos ston pa'i khyad par ni/ gdul bya'i bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du chos thams cad bdag tu grub pa'i ngo bo nyid med pa dang sogs pas pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang sems bskyed bsngo ba sogs ston par byed pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ gang de la gzugs mi rtag ces bya bar de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyi ston cing*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad kyang rnam mkhyen nyid ma gtogs par/ nyan thos kyi sa'am rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su bsngor mi 'jug go/ /zhes so/ /'gal rkyen spangs pa'i khyad par ni/ snga ma de'i mi mthun phyogs nyan rang gi yid byed dang ldan pas stong nyid kyi don la sngangs pa dang*/ skrag pa dang*/ kun tu skrag pa rnams dang*/ phyi ma de'i mi mthun phyogs theg chen gyi gzhung lam 'bras bu spong du 'jug pa'i sdig grogs kyi mtshan nyid bor ba'o/ /byang chen gyi sdig pa'i grogs po ni sher phyin dang 'bral bar byed pa dang*/ zhes so/ /de lta bu'i yon tan can gyi dge bshes byang sems de ni/

rnam pa kun tu theg pa chen po'i lam zhugs rnams kyi yongs 'dzin yin no// sgrub pa'i rten/ gsum pa sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo bshad pa la bzhi ste/ sgrub pa 'byung ba'i rten rigs/ sgrub pa'i yul dmigs pa/ sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba/ sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo'o/ /dang po (sgrub pa 'byung ba'i rten rigs )la gnyis te/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung don no/ /dang po la gnyis te/ rigs kyi ngo bo/ /dbye ba'o/ /dang po (rigs kyi ngo bo )la/ theg dman gyi lugs la/ rigs kyi ngo bo ni/ sems byung ma chags pa/ de la dbye na/ chos gos/ bsod snyoms dang*/ gnas mal ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa'i 'phags rigs dang*/ spong ba dang sgom pa la dga' ba 'phags pa'i rigs bzhi/ de'i dang po gsum gyis tshul dang*/ mtha' mas las bstan no zhes 'chad la/ de ni rigs yod pa'i rtags tsam bstan gyi de'i rang mtshan dngos ma bstan no// theg chen gyi lugs la/ gang 'bras bu 'byung rung gi nyer len gyi rgyu ni rigs yin la/ de yang myang 'das kyi rgyu ni kun gzhi'i ye shes dang*/ 'khor ba'i rgyu ni kun gzhi'i rnam shes la brten pa ste/ thog ma med pa'i dus kyi dbyings/ /chos rnams kun gyi gnas yin te/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /ye shes de ni de bzhin nyid/ bde gshegs snying po/ 'gyur med yongs grub/ don dam bden pa/ chos dbyings 'dus ma byas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ chos kyi sku/ sems kyi chos nyid/ skye mched drug gi khyad par/ zag pa med pa'i sa bon sogs ming gi rnam grangs du ma dang ldan pa gsal stong zung 'jug 'gyur med rtag pa'i bdag dam pa ste/ 'di skabs sgrub pa'i rten du gyur pa'i rang bzhin gnas rigs kyang 'di kho na'o/ /de ltar nyi snang du/ rtag cing chos kyi de kho na nyid yin pa la sogs pas rigs de ni rtag pa yin no/ /zhes so/ /kun gzhi 'di klu sgrub yab sras kyis dbu ma'i gzhung las bkag pa ma yin nam zhe na/

de dag las ni kun gzhi la bden 'dzin 'gog gi de'i rang bzhin mi 'gog ste/ ye shes kyi cha ni stong nyid la 'chad cing*/ rnam shes kyi cha ni/ de bzhin kun gzhi'i rnam shes ni/ /rdzun yang bden pa lta bur ni/ /zhes sems 'grel las gsungs pas so/ /de ni rang ngo nas dag pa gnyis ldan yin te/ chos dbyings bstod par/ dus rnams kun tu nyon mongs med/ /thog ma bar mtha' dri ma bral/ /zhes so/ /des na snying po mtshan nyid pa de sems can la yod ces smra ba ni don dam du mi rung ste/ sems can ni kun gzhi'i rnam shes 'khrul pa'i cha gzod nas grub ma myong ba la bzhag dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na ci sems can rnams sangs rgyas yin nam zhe na/ de yang ma yin te/ glo bur 'jig nges te rtag pa yin pa mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang tha snyad kyi ngor snying po de yi phyogs gcig rang bzhin rnam dag gi cha sems can la sems can gyi rgyud kyis ma bsdus/ ma 'dres/ ma 'brel bar yod pa tsam zhig gzhi'i dus su bzhag tu rung ste/ rgyud blar/ ma 'brel thog ma med pa nas/ /zhes so/ /skabs 'dir sems can sangs rgyas kyi rgyu ma yin kyi sangs rgyas nyid sangs rgyas pa yin no zhes pa 'di bzung ngo*/ /'di dang mthun par dpal rang byung zhabs kyang bzhed de/ nang don rang 'grel gyi snying po'i skabs su/ rgyu mtshan 'di ma rtogs par/ da ltar 'bras bu yod par 'chad pa dang*/ nyon mongs spang du med pa dang*/ gnyen po ye shes gsar du bskyed du med pa dang*/ rang bzhin gyi dag pa med dgag 'ba' zhig gi phyogs su 'chad pa ni rdo rje theg pa las ring ngo*/ /zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa (dbye ba )la gnyis te/ rtsa ba'i dbye ba/ rgyas 'gyur rigs kyi sgo nas dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rigs de la thog ma nas myang 'das kyi rten nam ngo bor gyur pa'i dri bcas sems kyi de bzhin nyid dri ma dang bral na chos skur 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin gnas rigs dang*/

de'i dri ma zad bzhin pa gzugs sku'i rgyur gyur pa'i rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs gnyis so// gnyis pa (rgyas 'gyur rigs kyi sgo nas dbye ba )ni/ theg pa gsum gyi nges pa'i rigs dang ma nges pa'i rigs dang rigs chad pa ste lngar/ lang kar gshegs pa las gsungs so/ /de'i dang po gsum ni/ rang rang gi myang 'das ma thob bar du/ rang lam las gzhan du mi 'gro ba'o/ /de ni nyi khri snang bar/ chos kyi dbyings 'di nyid kho na 'phags pa'i chos rnams kyi rgyur gyur pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes dang*/ 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad ni 'dus ma byas pa las byung ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gang rtogs bya'i snying po gcig nyid la/ rtogs tshul dman 'bring mchog gi dbye bas gsum du bzhag cing*/ de ltar na gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pas kyang chos kyi dbyings kyi cha shas tsam rtogs pa yin la/ nges pa'i don du rigs kyi ngo bo chos dbyings gcig nyid yin pas/ theg pa yang gcig kho na dang de'i 'bras bu myang 'das kyang gcig tu 'dod par dbu sems mtshungs la/ drang don du theg pa gsum du 'dod pa sems tsam pa'i lugs so// ma nges pa ni/ rang lam ma rdzogs pa nas theg pa gzhan gyi lam du 'jug pa ste/ de la nyan thos so skye ni rigs ma nges par drod rtse la gnas pa theg chen dang bzod 'bring nas rang rgyal du 'gyur ba yod/ 'phags pa la'ang phyir 'ong dang phyir mi 'ong dag smon lam dang sprul pa'i stobs kyis 'dod par skye ba blangs nas rang rgyal lam sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba srid do/ /rang rgyal ni bse ru lta bu drod/ tshogs spyod chen po bzod chen/ chung ngu mthong lam man chad ma nges so/ /byang sems ni dbang rnon sbyor lam/ dbang 'bring mthong lam/ dbang rtul sa brgyad pa man chad ma nges pa'o/ /rigs chad pa ni rnam grol dka' ba la dgongs nas/ mtshams med spyad pa/ log lta can/ thar pa cha mthun ma skyes pa/ cung zad yod kyang tshogs ma rdzogs pa dang bzhi la btags so//

gnyis pa tshig gi don la gnyis te/ rigs kyi dbye ba/ phye ba la rtsod pa spang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rtogs pa yi ni chos drug dang*// gnyen po dang ni spong ba dang*// de dag yongs su gtugs pa dang*// shes rab snying brtser bcas pa dang*// slob ma thun mong min nyid dang*// gzhan gyi don gyi go rim dang*// ye shes rtsol ba mi mnga' bar// 'jug pa'i rten la rigs shes bya// theg chen sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i rten du gyur pa de la sangs rgyas kyi rigs zhes bya ba yin la/ 'di'i rten brten pa'i don ni/ snod du bcud brten pa lta bu ma yin gyi/ rigs kyi rang bzhin mngon du gyur pa na gnas skabs su sgrub pa bcu gsum rim gyi thob pa'i don yin no// de la bcu gsum ni/ sbyor lam bzhi/ mthong lam/ sa bdun pa man gyi sgom lam ste rtogs pa'i ni chos drug gi rtenarigs drug las dang po ni/ mdo las/ rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na nam mkha' la bya'i rjes med cing mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin byang sems kyi tshig gi don med cing mi dmigs so/ /zhes bya ba dang*/ rmi lam/ sgyu ma/ smig rgyu/ sgra brnyan/ mig yor/ gzugs brnyan/ dri za'i grong khyer/ sprul pa la gnas med ces dpe dgus drod kyi rtog pa dgu mtshon nas/ de dag gnas med ces bkag pa'i shul gyi chos dbyings drod kyi rten rigs su bstan pa'o/ /de bzhin sbyor lam gzhan dang*/ mthong sgom lam rnams la yang rang rang gi spang bya'i rtog pa dang dpe sbyar nas gsungs so// bdun pa rtog pa'i chos de dag gi mthus spang bya sgrib gnyis kyi gnyen po bar chad med lam 'byung bas de'i rten rigs dang ni/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mngon par 'char ba'i tshe mun pa'i gnas med ces so// brgyad pa de yi mthus nyon sgrib ma lus par spong ba'i rnam grol lam gyi rten dang*/ bskal pa'i me 'bar ba'i tshe 'du byed kyi gnas med ces so//

dgu pa de dag yongs su gtugs pa ste/ sa brgyad pa'i shes sgrib spong ba'i rnam grol lam gyi rten dang*/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi tshul khrims la tshul khrims ngan pa'i gnas med ces so/ /'di'i spang gnyen ni/ rkun po 'byin pa dang sgo gcod pa bzhin/ gnyen po bar chad med lam skyes pa'i tshe spang bya 'gag pa la phyogs shing*/ de 'gags pa na rnam grol lam skye ba yin no// bcu pa srid zhi la mi gnas par byed pa'i rang bzhin med rtogs kyi shes rab snying brtser bcas pa'i yon tan khyad par can gyi rten dang*/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i 'od la gnas med ces so/ /spang gnyen dang shes rab snying rje'i sgrub pa ni sa brgyad par bzhag ste/ 'jug pa las/ sa brgyad pa la dri ma de dag rtsa bcas nye bar zhi 'gyur zhing*// nyon mongs zad cing sa gsum bla mar gyur nas kyang*// zhes dang*/ rgyan las/ yid dang 'dzin dang rnam par rtog/ gyur phyir rnam par mi rtog pa// zhes dang*/ srid dang zhi bar mi rtog pa/ /zhes dang*/ ga ya go ri'i mdo las/ sa brgyad pa man chad la shes pa'i lam yan chad la/ spong ba'i lam du bshad pa dang mthun par mngon no// bcu gcig pa de'i phyir slob ma nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang thun mong min pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med par khyab pa'i ye shes nyid kyi rten dang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang*/ gza' dang skar ma dang nor bu rin po che dang glog gi 'od la gnas med ces so// bcu gnyis pa gdul bya gzhan theg pa gsum gyi rigs can dag rang rang gi bsam don gyi go rim dang mthun par 'bras bu la 'god pa'i ched du/ ldem por dgongs pa dang dgongs pa bzhi'i sgo nas sgrub pa'i rten dang*/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha rnams kyi 'od la gnas med ces so// 'di'i skabs su dgongs te gsungs pa la bzhi las/ 1 mnyam pa nyid gsum la dgongs pa ni/ tshogs chos sku 'gro don te mnyam pa nyid gsum rgyu mtshan du mdzad nas/

nga de'i tshe rnam gzigs su gyur to/ /zhes pa lta bu'o// 2 don gzhan la dgongs pa ni/ kun brtags gzhan dbang yongs grub gsum la mtshan nyid skye ba don dam pa'i ngo bo nyid med pa gsum rgyu mtshan du mdzad nas/ chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med pa'o/ /zhes pa lta bu'o// 3 dus gzhan la dgongs pa ni/ dus nam zhig bde ba can du skye ba rgyu mtshan du mdzad nas/ bde ba can du skye bar smon lam btab na der skye'o zhes pa lta bu'o// 4 gang zag gi bsam pa la dgongs pa ni/ tshul khrims kho nas chog par 'dzin pa'i gang zag sbyin pa la sogs thabs gzhan la gzhug par dgongs nas/ tshul khrims la smad sbyin pa la bstod pa lta bu'o// ldem dgongs la bzhi las/ 1 gzhug pa ldem dgongs ni/ nyon thos kyi rigs can gzhug pa'i don du skrag pa spang ba'i phyir/ gzugs yod do zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o// 2 mtshan nyid ldem dgongs ni/ ngo bo nyid med pa gsum gyi rang mtshan gsal bar ston par bzhed nas/ ngo bo nyid med do zhes pa lta bu'o// 3 gnyen po ldem dgongs ni/ nyes pa brgyad 'dul ba'i gnyen por gsungs pa lta bu'o// 4 bsgyur ba ldem por dgongs pa ni/ la la zhig dam chos 'di go sla ba'i phyir mi zab par rtog pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ pha dang ma ni bsad bya zhing*// rgyal po gtsang sbra can gnyis dang*// yul 'khor bskor dang bcas bcom na// mi de dag pa nyid du 'gyur// zhes pa lta bu'o/ /de'i don pha ma ni sred len/ rgyal po kun gzhi/ lta ba mtha' ma gnyis gtsang sbra can gnyis/ skye mched drug yul dang bcas pa yul 'khor bskor dang bcas pa'i ming gis bstan nas de dag med par byas na/ byang chub thob pa'i don no// dgongs ldem dgongs kyi khyad par ni/ dang po ni gsung ba po nyid kyi thugs la bzhag pa tsam dang*/ gnyis pa ni pha rol gzud pa'i don du'o//de yang 'di la dgongs nas gsungs zhes dang 'di'i ched du gsungs zhes sgra ji bzhin las don logs na btsal dgos pas gnyis ka drang don yin no//
