bcu gsum pa ye shes rtsol ba mi mnga' bar lhun grub tu 'jug pa'i rten la rigs zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'od la gnas med ces so// de ltar rigs la brten pa'i sgrub pa bcu gsum po 'di rnams kyi rim pa mngon par rtogs pa ji ltar skye ba'i tshul dang mthun cing rdzogs sangs don gnyer gyi skyes bu'i lam tshang ba zhig bstan to// 'di dag gi sa mtshams/ dang po drug /sa bdun pa man chad/ de 'og bzhi/ sa brgyad pa na/ de nas rim bzhin sa dgu pa/ bcu pa/ rgyun mtha' rnams so// gnyis pa rtsod pa la gnyis te/ phyogs snga dang*/ lan no/ /dang po ni/ chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir// rigs ni tha dad rung ma yin// skye bo blo gros dman pa 'ga' zhig khyed cag chos dbyings rigs su 'dod pa de'i tshe/ chos kyi dbyings la tha dad du dbyer med pa'i phyir/ rigs la ni gsum dang bcu gsum sogs su tha dad du dbyer rung ba ma yin no snyam srid na zhes dogs slongs so// gnyis pa lan ni/ brten pa'i chos kyi bye brag gis// de yi dbye ba yongs su brjod// de lta bu'i skyon mi gnas te/ dper na rten bum pa gcig yin kyang de'i nang du brten pa'i chos bcud sbrang rtsi dang li kha ra la sogs kyi bye brag gis res 'ga' sbrang rtsi'i bum pa res li kha ra'i bum pa zhes rten de'i dbye ba yongs su brjod pa ltar/ rten rtogs bya'i rigs gcig yin kyang de la brten nas/ de rtogs tshul mchog dman tha dad du byung bas de ltar phye ba'i phyir ro//

sgrub pa'i dmigs pa*/ gnyis pa sgrub pa'i dmigs pa la gnyis te/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung don no/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mi rung ba dgag /rang lugs bzhag pa'o/ /dang po (mi rung ba dgag pa )ni/ 'phags seng gi theg chen 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag la/ yang dag kun rdzob pa'i chos thams cad za 'og gi ri mo ltar ma 'dres gsal bar snang bar bzhed do/ /zhes zer ro/ /de mi 'thad pa ni/ mnyam bzhag de spros par thal/ kun rdzob snang ba'i steng du sgro 'dogs gcod byed kyi blo yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa (rang lugs bzhag pa )ni/ 'phags seng gi dgongs pa 'phags chen rnams kyi rnal 'byor dag bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu mi 'gal ba'i dbang du byas nas gsungs pa'am/ gcig tu na 'khrul pas ma bslad pa'i don dam rnam pa kun ldan gyi yul yul can dang dbyer med du snang ba la dgongs kyi/ de'i tshe gnyis snang gi yul yul can thams cad ngang gis nub pa kho na'o/ /des na dmigs pa'i skabs 'di mnyam rjes dbyer med kyi yul du bzung ba'am/ yang na mnyam bzhag gi sbyor ba'i dus sgro 'dogs gcad byar bzhag pa'o// gnyis pa gzhung don la gsum ste/ mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa/ ji ltar dmigs pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ dmigs pa chos rnams thams cad de// rigs la brten pa'i sgrub pa de dag gi dmigs pa gang zhe na/ de ni chos rnams thams cad de de la dmigs so/ /gnyis pa (rgyas par bshad pa )ni/ de yang dge la sogs pa yin// 'jig rten pa yi rtogs pa dang*// gang dag 'jig rten 'das 'dod dang*// zag bcas zag pa med chos dang*// gang dag 'dus byas 'dus ma byas// slob ma thun mong chos rnams dang*// gang dag thub pa'i thun mong min// chos rnams thams cad ces pa de yang dbye na bcu gcig tu 'gyur te/ 'di ltar/ dge sbyong gi tshul zag med bar chad med lam sogs dge ba dang la sogs pas de'i mi mthun phyogs mi dge ba dang de gnyis las gzhan pa'i lung ma bstan gyi las te gsum ni dbye sgo dang po yin no//

de la dge ba ni/ 'bras bu bde ba sbyin byed de/ de yang ngo bo nyid kyis dge bar gnas pa ni/ dad sogs dge ba bcu gcig go /mtshungs ldan gyi dge ba ni/ de dag dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems sems byung ngo*/ /kun nas bslangs pa'i dge ba ni/ de dag gis kun nas bslangs pa'i lus ngag gi las sogs so// mi dge ba ni/ rnam smin sdug bsngal 'byin byed de/ ngo bo nyid kyi mi dge ba ni/ 'jig mthar gnyis/ de dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i ma rig pa ma gtogs pa'i 'dod khams kyi rtsa nyon nye nyon rnams so/ /de la khams gong gi nyon mongs pa rnams dang 'jig mthar/ de gnyis dang mtshungs ldan gyi ma rig pa rnams sgribs la lung du ma bstan pa yin no/ /mtshungs ldan gyi mi dge ba ni/ de dag dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems sems byung ngo*/ /kun nas bslangs pa'i mi dge ba ni/ de dag gis kun nas bslangs pa'i lus ngag gi las so// lung ma bstan ni/ rnam smin 'byin mi nus pa sa bon rul ba lta bu ste/ sgribs lung ma bstan rnams kyis ni lus ngag gi las kyi kun slong mi byed do//ma sgribs lung ma bstan gyi nam mkha' dang so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pa gnyis la don dam pa'i lung ma bstan zhes bya zhing*/ des kun slong mi byed par ma zad mtshungs ldan gyi tha snyad kyang mi byed do/ /des na ngo bo nyid kyi lung ma bstan ni/ rnam smin gyi rgyu la ma 'bad par ngang gis skyes pa'i sems dang*/ 'gro 'chag sogs spyod lam dus kyi yul gzugs la dmigs pa'i dang*/ bzo slob pa dang byed dus gnas pa'i dang*/ sprul pa bya 'dod dang byed dus kyi yul la dmigs pa'i sems bzhi'o/ de dag ma sgribs lung ma bstan nyid yin cing*/ 'dod pa na bzhi char/ gzugs na bzo ma gtogs pa/ gzugs med na rnam smin skyes kho na yod do/ /mtshungs ldan gyi lung ma bstan ni/ de dag dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems sems byung ngo*/

kun nas bslangs pa'i lung ma bstan ni/ de dag gis kun nas bslangs pa'i lus ngag gi las so// de ltar dbye ba gsum po kho na yin nam zhe na/ gzhan du yang dbyer yod de/ 'jig rten pa ste so so skye bo'i rgyud rtog pas bsdus pa'i phung khams skye mched dge bcu bsam gzugs mngon shes dag dang*/ gang dag 'jig rten las 'das par 'dod pa 'phags pa'i skye bo rnams kyi rgyud ye shes kyis bsdus pa'i bsam gtan chos so bdun/ dbang po ting nge 'dzin rnam thar brgyad/ mthar gnas dgu la sogs pa ste gnyis su phye ba dang*/ yang bdag tu lta ba dang ldan pa'i zag bcas dang*/ der lta ba'i gnyen po zag pa med pa'i chos gnyis su phye ba dang*/ 'dir zag bcas zag med kyi don/ gang la brten nas zag pa nyon mongs skye ba dang mi skye ba'i don yin la/ bye smra ltar na/ lam bden ma gtogs pa'i 'dus byas thams cad zag bcas/ lam bden dang 'dus ma byas gsum zag med du 'dod/ des na sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku zag bcas su khas len no/ /theg chen lugs la/ kun tu spyod pa ma zhi ba'i dang*/ phyi nang 'gyur ba'i dang*/ nyes spyod kun nas slong bar byed pa'i dang*/ srid pa'i rgyu byed pa'i nyes pa ste/ nyes pa rnam bzhi skyed byed la zag bcas dang*/ de dag mi bskyed pa la zag med du 'chad pas/ sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku yang zag med du 'dod do// zag pa de dag rgyas par 'gyur tshul/ mdzod las byung ba cung zad gong du bshad zin la/ kun btus su ni/ rgyas par 'gyur ba'i sgo drug gsungs te/ rtsa nyon dang nye nyon lta bu zag pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de dag dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems sems byung ni zag pa dang 'brel ba'i'o/ /sa gzhan gyi kun gzhi'i rnam shes las gzhan gyi nyon mongs kyi bag chags yod pa lta bu zag pa dang rjes su 'brel ba'i'o/ /rgyud zag pa las ma grol dus kyi dge ba bsam gtan la sogs pa ni zag pas bcings pa'i'o/

/zag pa dang dmigs rnam mthun pa tshogs lam lta bu ni zag pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i'o/ /dgra bcom pa lta bu'i zag bcas kyi phung po lnga ni/ zag pa'i rgyu las byung ba'i sgo'o// yang chos gang dag kun rdzob tu rgyu rkyen tshogs pa las byung ba 'dus byas dang*/ rgyu rkyen la rag ma lus shing skye 'jig dang bral ba de bzhin nyid lta bu 'dus ma byas te gnyis su phye ba dang*/ yang slob ma ste nyan rang gi rgyud dang thun mong ba'i yon tan gyi chos bsam gtan bzhi la sogs pa rnams dang*/ gang dag thub pa sangs rgyas kyi gzhan dang thun mong min pa'i yon tan stobs bcu sogs te gnyis su phye ba de ltar dmigs pa bcu gcig go/ mdo ni/ dge ba dang mi dge ba dang lung du ma bstan pa dang 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa dang zag pa dang bcas pa dang zag pa med pa dang 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas dang thun mong dang thun mong min pa ste/ rab 'byor de dag ni chos thams cad ces bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so// gsum pa ji ltar dmigs pa'i tshul ni/ 'di ni blang bya'o/ /'di ni dor bya'o/ /'di btang snyoms su bzhag bya'o snyam du dang po gsum la dmigs/ de'i blang bya la yang dang po blang bya 'di phyis blang bya 'di snyam du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam dang*/ de nas 'das lam gyi spang bya 'di/ ngo bo 'di snyam du zag pa yod med dang*/ de nas zag med lam de'i dmigs pa 'di snyam du 'dus byas kun rdzob dang*/ 'dus ma byas don dam bden pa dang*/ de'i snga ma ma grub par rtogs nas phyi ma la dmigs pas 'bras bu dman mchog 'di ltar 'byung snyam du thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan la dmigs pa'o// sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba/ gsum pa sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba ni/ sems can kun mchog nyid sems dang*// spong dang rtogs dang gsum po la// chen po gsum gyi rang 'byung gi/ ched du bya ba 'di shes bya//

'o na sgrub pa de'i ched du bya ba yang dmigs pa dag yin nam zhe na/ de ni ma yin gyi/ dmigs pa ni da ltar ba dper na mda' ltong sbyor ba lta bu yin la/ ched du gnyer bya ni ma 'ongs par 'byung rung mda' 'ben la phog pa lta bu yin no/ des na ched du bya ba ni bsgrub bya lam ma zhugs nas sa bcu rgyun mthar gnas pa'i bar gyi sems can kun gyi mchog nyid du 'gyur ba'i sems gnyis med kyi ye shes chos sku dang*/ de la sgrib byed glo bur gyi dri ma spangs pa'i spong ba dang*/ de'i gnas tshul mtha' dag rtogs pa dang ste gsum po de la rim bzhin sgrub byed chen po gsum gyi mthu dang ldan pa'i ched du'o// de las sems chen po ni/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi rdo rje lta bu'i sems sogs drug go /mdo ni/ sems can gyi phung po chen po dang*/ sems can gyi sde chen po kun gyi mchog nyid du byed par 'gyur ba de'i phyir sems dpa' chen po zhes bya'o/ /zhes so// spong ba chen po ni/ de'i rgyud kyi bdag gnyis su lta ba mtha' dag spong byed kyi bar chad med lam mo/ /thabs mkhas pas lta ba'i rnam pa de dag spang ba'i phyir mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos ston no/ /zhes so// rtogs pa chen po ni/ de rgyud kyi rtogs pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi sems mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i sems zhes pa nas/ byang sems zhes bgyi ba'i grangs su mchi'o/ /zhes so/ /de ltar rang nyid sangs rgyas su 'byung bar 'gyur ba dag gi byang sems kyi sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba ni 'di gsum du nges zhes bya ste/ dper na/ g.yul sprod pa'i ched du bya ba ni/ rang nyid 'gran zla med par bya ba dang*/ pha rol dgra gzhom pa dang*/ de'i yul sogs rang gis thob par byed pa dang gsum du nges pa bzhin no// bzhi pa sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo la gsum ste/ sgrub pa spyi'i ngo bo/ bye brag gi sa mtshams/

so so'i don no// dang po ni/ theg chen sgrub pa tsam gyi ngo bo ni/ sems bskyed la gnas nas rang gzhan gyi don rtsom pa rgya che zhing*/ 'bras bu byang chen thob nges pa'i bya ba'o/ /'dir ni rnam kun sogs sbyor bzhi nyid la/ mkhyen gsum yul du byed pa lta ba'i cha dang*/ phar phyin drug sgrub pa spyod pa'i cha gnyis su yod pa'i snga ma ni/ sbyor bzhi'i rgyas bshad du 'chad la/ phyi ma ni go sgrub sogs bzhi ste/ rgyu bsam sbyor gyi brtson 'grus kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i bya ba gnyis/ 'bras bu rgyud nas dang dngos su 'byin pa'i bya ba gnyis so// gnyis pa (bye brag gi sa mtshams )ni/ slob dpon gyi sgrub pa bzhi po dang por thob pa'i sa mtshams sbyor mthong sgom gsum rgyun mtha'i ye shes rnams su sbyar la/ brgyad stong 'grel chen du ni/ sbyor lam la rgyud nas dang nye bar dang dngos su sbyor ba'i sgo nas tshogs lam drod sogs gsum/ chos mchog rnams su sgrub pa dang po gsum dang por thob pa'i sa mtshams dang nges 'byung sgrub pa'i sa mtshams sngar bzhin no// go cha'i sgrub pa/ gsum pa (so so'i don )la bzhi ste/ drug tshan drug go cha'i sgrub pa/ 'jug pa rnam pa dgu'i sgrub pa/ tshogs bcu bdun gyi sgrub pa/ nges 'byung sgrub pa brgyad bshad pa'o/ /dang po (drug tshan drug go cha'i sgrub pa )la gnyis te/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung don no/ /dang po la lnga ste/ phar phyin drug so so'i rang bzhin/ grangs nges/ go rim/ 'bras bu/ sgra bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ gtong ba'i chos bzhi ldan nas/ spong ba'i sems mi 'khrugs pa/ dge la spro ba/ sems rtse gcig pa/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed chos bzhi ldan rnams rim bzhin phyin drug gi ngo bo'o/ /chos bzhi ni/ rgyan las/ sbyin pa mi mthun phyogs nyams byed// rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan// 'dod pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed// sems can rnam smin byed rnam gsum//

zhes gsungs pa ltar sbyar ro// de dag la dbye na rim pa bzhin/ sbyin pa la chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs pa'o/ /tshul khrims la yang dag par blangs pa so thar sdom pa dang chos nyid kyis thob pa bsam gtan dang zag med kyi sdom pa'o/ /bzod pa la/ gnod pa la mi mjed pa dang sdug bsngal la ji mi snyam pa dang chos la nges par rtog pa'o/ /brtson 'grus la/ bslab pa gsum la lus dang sems kyi brtson 'grus rtsom pa drug thun mong du gus sbyor dang rtag sbyor te bdun no/ /bsam gtan la/ rtog dpyod bcas pa dang rtog med dpyod tsam dang*/ rtog med dpyod med do/ /shes rab la/ 'jig rten pa'i dang 'jig rten las 'das pa chung ngu nyan rang gi dang chen po theg chen gyi shes rab bo// gnyis pa (grangs nges )ni/ bslab pa gsum gyi dbang du byas te/ dang po gsum gyis tshul khrims/ phyi ma gnyis kyi sems dang shes rab brtson 'grus ni thams cad kyi grogs so// gsum pa (go rim )ni/ rgyan las/ snga ma la brten phyi ma skye// dman dang mchog tu gnas phyir dang*// rags pa dang ni phra ba'i phyir// de dag rim par bstan pa yin// zhes pa ltar ro// bzhi pa ('bras bu )ni/ rin chen phreng ba las/ sbyin pas longs spyod khrims kyis bde// bzod pas mdangs ldan brtson pas brjid// bsam gtan gyis zhi blo yis grol// snying brtse bas ni don kun 'grub// bdun po 'di dag ma lus pa// cig car pha rol phyin pa yis// ye shes bsam mi khyab pa'i yul// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid thob// ces gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu gsungs pa ltar ro// lnga pa (sgra bshad pa )ni/ rgyan las/ dbul ba 'dor bar byed pa dang*// bsil ba thob dang khro bzod dang*// mchog sbyor ba dang yid 'dzin dang*// don dam shes pa'i phyir bshad do// zhes pa ltar ro// gnyis pa gzhung gi don ni/ de dag so sor sbyin la sogs// rnam pa drug tu bsdus pa yis//

go cha'i sgrub pa gang yin te// drug tshan drug gis ji bzhin bshad// rigs la brten pa'i sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo la bzhi las gnod pas mi tshugs par bya ba'i phyir go cha'i grub pa thog mar bstan pa ni/ bsam pa rgya che ba gzhan don kho nar dmigs nas/ sgrub pa rgya che ba gong du bstan pa'i phar phyin drug po de dag so sor te/ re rer yang sbyin pa la sogs phar phyin rnam pa drug drug tu bsdus pa'i sgo nas go cha'i sgrub pa gang yin pa de ni drug tshan drug gis mdo ji lta ba bzhin du bshad do/ /mdo ni/ byang chen sbyin pa'i phar phyin la de ltar spyod pa ni phar phyin drug po thams cad yongs su 'dzin te/ de'i phyir go cha chen po bgos zhes bya'o/ /zhes so// re re la drug drug tu bsdu ba'i tshul ni/ chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa sbyin pa'i sbyin pa/ rang don yid byed sogs spong ba sbyin pa'i tshul khrims/ slong ba po sogs kyis mi snyan par smra ba la mi khro ba ni sbyin pa'i bzod pa/ de nyid gong nas gong du spel ba'i 'dun pa bskyed pa sbyin pa'i brtson 'grus/ nyan rang gi theg pa dang ma 'dres par sems rtse gcig pa nyid kyis rdzogs byang du bsngo ba sbyin pa'i bsam gtan/ sbyin bya sbyin byed sbyin yul mi dmigs pas rgyas 'debs pa sbyin pa'i shes rab ste/ de dag ni sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi go cha'i sgrub pa'o//

de ltar lhag ma tshul khrims sogs la yang rim gyis sbyar te/ le brgyad mar/ dge ba sems can dang thun mong du byas te byang chub tu bsngo ba tshul khrims sogs kyi sbyin pa dang*/ de 'og gsum 'dra la rnam mkhyen la sems rtse gcig pas dge rtsa bsngo ba bsam gtan dang shes rab kyang snga ma dang 'dra bar gsungs so// 'jug sgrub/ gnyis pa 'jug pa rnam dgu'i sgrub pa la gnyis te/ spyir bshad pa/ rtogs dka' ba bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bsam gtan gzugs med sbyin sogs dang*// lam dang byams la sogs pa dang*// dmigs pa med dang ldan pa dang*// 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa dang*// ched du bya dang mngon shes drug/ rnam kun mkhyen pa'i tshul la ni// 'jug pa'i sgrub pa theg chen la// 'dzeg pa yin par shes par bya// de ltar go cha bgos pa'i rjes nas theg chen gyi lam la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa ni dgu las/ dang po sems brtan par bya ba'i phyir bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi ting nge 'dzin la rnam rtags mtshan ma mi dmigs par 'jug pa'i sgrub pa dang*/ mdo ni/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin la spyod cing 'dod pas dben/ zhes sogs so// gnyis pa tshogs gsog par bya ba'i phyir sbyin sogs phar phyin drug dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa spang ba'i phyir chos bstan par bya'o snyam pa 'di ni sems dpa' chen po'i sbyin pa'i phar phyin no/ /zhes so// gsum pa de kho na nyid rtogs par bya ba'i phyir mthong lam sa bdun pa man gyi sgom lam mi slob lam ste sa brgyad pa dang khyad par gyi lam sa dgu pa dang bcu pa dang*/ rnam pa thams cad du byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun sgom pa dang*/ zhes so// bzhi pa gzhan don sgrub pa'i byams pa la sogs pa'i tshad med bzhi dang*/ byams pa dang ldan pa'i sems yangs pa rgya chen por gyur pa/ zhes so// lnga pa de la 'ching byed bden 'dzin spong ba'i phyir dmigs pa la 'dzin pa med pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa dang*/

nang stong pa nyid ces kyang dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin no/ zhes so// drug pa de'i mthus bya byed las gsum la 'khor gsum gyi spyod pa rnam par dag pa dang*/ sbyin pa po dang len pa po dang sbyin pa rnams dmigs su med/ ces so// bdun pa rang don gyi ched du bya ba chen po gsum dang*/ sgom pa rnam par gzhig pa'i don du byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyi sgom/ zhes so// brgyad pa mthu'i khyad par thob phyir mngon shes drug la/ mngon par shes pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir na/ zhes so// dgupa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i phyir rnam kun mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi tshul la ni 'jug pa'i sgrub pa'o/ /rnam mkhyen nyid thob nas kyang chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar byed pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de ltar lam dgu la so sor 'jug pa'i sgrub pa rnams ni theg pa chen po la 'dzeg pa yin par shes par bya'o// theg pa chen po'i don ni/ chen po bdun dang ldan pa la 'jog cing*/ bdun ni/ gsung rab rgya chen po la dmigs pa/ don gnyis sgrub pa/ bdag med gnyis rtogs pa'i ye shes/ brtson 'grus/ /nyon mongs kyis mi gos pa'i thabs mkhas/ stobs sogs yang dag par grub pa/ phrin las chen po rnams so// gnyis pa rtogs dka' ba bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis te/ bsam gzugs dang*/ tshad med pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po (bsam gzugs )la bzhi ste/ skye ba'i rten/ thob pa'i rgyu/ rang gi ngo bo/ /'bras bu'o/ /dang po ni/ rnam smin gyi sgrib pa can ngan song gsum sgra mi snyan dang*/ las sgrib can za ma ma ning rnams ma gtogs pa'i 'gro ba thams cad do/ /de yang rgyu'i snyoms 'jug 'og sa dang*/ 'bras bu'i snyoms 'jug rang sa'i rten can yin la/ tshangs ris kyi nyer bsdogs dang dngos gzhi gsar du thob pa 'dod rten/ tshangs mdun gyi de tshangs ris man/ de ltar tshangs chen nas 'du shes med min gyi bar la 'gre'o/

/thob zin gnas pa 'dod pa nas srid rtse'i bar thams cad la mngon du 'gyur ba yod do// 'di las 'phros nas gang zag la mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug gang ldan dpyad na/ lam ma zhugs la mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dang po brgyad gang rung dang ldan pa yod cing*/ lam zhugs la theg pa gsum las dang po la/ cig car ba'i nyan thos dgra bcom thob ma thag man la tshangs ris kyi nyer bsdogs kho na ldan/ de ni shes rab rkyang grol yin la/ des bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi sgrub pa dgra bcom rgyan can yin cing*/ de la bsam gtan dang po yan chad kyi snyoms 'jug kyang ldan mi ldan ci rigs yod do/ /chags bral sngon song gi phyir 'ong gi rigs can gyi sbyor lam chos mchog man du tshangs ris kyi nyer bsdogs dang po bzhi dang nges par ldan/ phyi ma gnyis ldan mi ldan ci rigs yod/ de'i sdug bsngal chos bzod nas phyir 'ong gi 'bras bu thob bar phyi ma gsum ldan mi ldan ci rigs so/ /chags bral sngon song gi phyir mi 'ong gi rigs can gyi chos mchog man du tshangs ris kyi dngos gzhi nges par ldan/ tshangs mdun nas srid rtse'i bar ldan mi ldan ci rigs so/ /de'i sdug bsngal chos bzod nas rgyun mtha' man la/ tshangs 'dun yan ldan mi ldan ci rigs so/ /rim gyis pa'i rgyun zhugs kyi sbyor lam chos mchog man la tshangs ris kyi nyer bsdogs dang po nges par ldan/ bar ma gsum ldan mi ldan ci rigs phyi ma gnyis nges par ma thob cing de yan gyi phyir 'ong 'bras bu la reg pa'i bar de dang 'dra/ phyir 'ong 'bras gnas kyi skabs su phyi ma gnyis ldan mi ldan ci rigs dngos gzhi nges par mi ldan no/ /rim gyis pa'i phyir mi 'ong ni chags bral sngon song gi skabs bzhin no/ /rang rgyal la skye ba dang lam gyi sgo nas gnyis las dang po ni/ skye ba gcig thogs man du tshangs ris gyi nyer bsdogs nyid ldan/

srid pa mtha' ma yan du de'i dngos gzhi dang ldan mi ldan ci rigs so/ /gnyis pa ni bse ru lta bu sbyor lam yan nas nges par bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi dang ldan/ tshogs spyod tshogs lam nas mi slob pa'i bar la bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob ma thob ci rigs yod do/ /theg chen la snyoms 'jug ma thob pa'i byang sems kyang yod do/ /theg chen tshogs lam 'bring gi skabs su'ang thob ma thob ci rigs yod/ tshogs lam chen po'i skabs su bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi nges par ldan zhing*/ sbyor lam tha ma'i skabs su srid rtse'i dngos gzhi nges par thob bo//sangs rgyas 'phags pa la snyoms 'jug rnams bye brag med par sgrib bral du ldan no// gnyis pa (thob pa'i rgyu+u )ni/ sngon ting nge 'dzin la goms pa dang*/ khams gong mar skye ba'i las rgya che ba/ snyoms 'jug ston pa'i gsung rab la thos bsam byas pa/ gzhan gyi man ngag gi mthu las bskal pa 'jig pa'i tshe chos nyid kyis thob pa ste lnga'o// gsum pa (rang gi ngo bo )la gnyis te/ nyer bsdogs/ dngos gzhi'o//dang po (nyer bsdogs )la gnyis te/ dbye ba/ rnam gzhag go/ dang po ni/ mtshan nyid rab tu rig pa yid byed/ mos pa las byung ba/ rab tu dben pa/ dga' ba sdud pa/ dpyod pa/ sbyor mtha' yid byed dang drug go /de'i dang po (mtshan nyid rab tu rig pa yid byed )ni/ 'dod pa la rags pa bsam gtan dang po la zhi bar lta ba'i thos bsam gyi sems te spang blang gi phyir sems 'jog go/ gnyis pa (mos pa las byung ba )ni/ zhi rags de la dmigs pa'i zhi lhag zung 'jug sgom pa de spang blang gi don du yang dag par sbyor ba rtsom mo/ /gsum pa (rab tu dben pa )ni/ zhi gnas la goms pa ste nyon mongs chen po gsum spong ngo*// bzhi pa (dga' ba sdud pa )ni/ de gsum spangs pa'i dga' bde cung zad thob pas gzhan yang spong bar spro ba'i yid byed de nyon mongs 'bring gsum spong ngo*//

lnga pa (dpyod pa )ni/ slar spong rgyu yod med dpyad pas phra mo yod par rtogs nas sdug pa'i mtshan ma yid la byed pas so sor rtog pa ste thob pa'i yon tan la nga rgyal med par byed do// drug pa (sbyor mtha' yid byed )ni/ phra ba rnams kyang spong bar yid la byed pa ste nyon mongs chung ngu gsum spong ngo*/ /'di rnams re re la gzugs khams su+u gnas kyi sgo nas bcu bdun du'ang 'gyur ro// drug po de dag yid byed kyi dang lam gyi sgo nas bzhir yang 'du ste/ mtshan nyid rab rig dang mos pa yid byed gnyis ni rjes su mthun pa yid byed de sbyor ba'i lam dang*/ rab dben dang sbyor mtha' yid byed gnyis ni gnyen po yid byed de bar chad med lam dang*/ dga' sdud ni dang bar gyur pa yid byed de lam bzhi char dang*/ dpyod pa yid byed ni so sor rtog pa yid byed de khyad par gyi lam gyis bsdus so// gnyis pa (rnam gzhag )ni/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs la ni dag pa ba dang zag med gnyis yod/ dang po yan chad la lam zag med kyang 'og sa'i dngos gzhi'i rten la sgrub pa'i phyir zag med med do/ /dang po la mi mtshungs te dngos gzhi ma thob pa'i rgyun zhugs sogs de'i nyer bsdogs la brten dgos pa'i phyir/ des na dang po'i nyer bsdogs la brten nas khams gsum las 'da' nus pas de la mi lcogs med pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /nyer bsdogs rnams 'og sa la chags pa dang bral byed kyi lam kho na yin pas nyon mongs can mi srid do/ /dngos gzhi dag gi ni 'og sa las 'da' bar mi byed cing*/ khyad par zag bcas ni mthong chos bder gnas dang yon tan mngon par sgrub pa'i lam yin gyi chags pa dang bral byed ma yin te rang sa'i sred pas bcings pa dang gong sa las dman pa'i phyir/ zag med kyis ni rang sa dang gong sa'i gnyen po byed pas 'dod chags dang bral byed kyi lam yang yin no/

/de ltar bsam gtan dang po nas srid rtse'i bar gyi nyer bsdogs rnams sgom tshul phal cher mtshungs la/ 'on kyang gzugs med kyi rten la yid byed dang po sgom byung ngo*// gnyis pa (dngos gzhi )la gnyis te/ yan lag gi sgo nas 'og sa las 'das pa bsam gtan bzhi/ 'du shes kyi sgo nas 'og sa las 'das pa gzugs med bzhi'o// dang po (bsam gtan bzhi )ni/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi ni yan lag lnga ldan te/ sems rtsing zhib kyi ngo bo rtog dpyod gnyis gnyen po'i yan lag sems la dga' ba dang lus la bde ba gnyis 'byung ba phan yon gyi yan lag sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin gnas kyi yan lag go /'di la rtog pa ni ches rags pas bsam gtan dang po la chags pa dang ma bral bas kyang spong nus pa'i phyir rtog dpyod gnyis ka dang bcas pa'i dngos gzhi tsam dang*/ rtog med dpyod tsam gyi dngos gzhi khyad par can gnyis su yang phye'o// gnyis pa ni yan lag bzhi ste/ bsam gtan gyi skyon rtog dpyod las 'das pa'i nang rab dang gnyen po'i yan lag tshor ba yid bde'i ngo bor gyur pa'i dga' bde gnyis phan yon gyi yan lag ting nge 'dzin gnas kyi yan lag gsum pa ni yan lag lnga ste/ dmigs rnam mi brjed par 'dzin pa'i dran pa bsam gtan la skyon byung ma byung dpyod pa'i shes bzhin bde sdug sogs kyi 'du byed dang bral ba'i 'du byed btang snyoms gsum gnyen po'i yan lag sems tshor bde ba phan yon gyi yan lag ting 'dzin gnas kyi yan lag go/ bzhi pa ni yan yag bzhi ste/ bsam gtan gyi skyon brgyad las grol ba'i dran pa dang 'du byed btang snyoms gnyis gnyen po'i yan lag tshor ba btang snyoms phan yon gyi yan lag ting 'dzin gnas kyi yan lag go/yan lag ces pa'i don ni de dang de'i ngo bo yin pa'o/ /'di rnams la gnas kyis phye na bcu bdun du 'gyur zhing ngo bo'i sgo nas phye na nyon mongs can/

dag pa ba/ zag med gsum/ dang po ni rang sa'i rtsa nyon nam nye nyon gyis bcings pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni 'jig rten pa'i dge ba zhi rags kyi rnam pa can te nyams pa cha mthun sogs bzhi yod do/ /gsum pa ni lhag mthong gi ngo bor gyur pa'i bden pa'i rnam pa can yin cing rtog dpyod dang mi ldan no// gnyis pa gzugs med bzhi ni/ sbyor ba'i dus su gzugs dang thogs pa'i 'du shes bshig nas chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar mtha' yas so snyam pa dang*/ rnam shes ltar mtha' yas so snyam pa dang*/ gzung bya rags pa ci yang med do snyam pa dang*/ gzung bya rags pa yod pa ma yin phra ba med pa ma yin snyam du yid la byas pas de rnams rim bzhin mngon du gyur pa'i snyoms 'jug go /de dag la ngo bos phye na dbu ma pas sngar ltar gsum du 'dod/ bye smras srid rtser ni zag med mi 'dod do// bzhi pa ('bras bu )ni/ 'bras bu skye ba'i bsam gzugs dang de'i gang zag rnams don gcig cing*/ gzugs khams kyi snod dang spyan mngon shes rnams bdag 'bras/ nyer len gyi phung po ni rnam smin gyi 'bras bu/ byang phyogs kyi chos rnams rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu'o// gnyis pa tshad med bzhi bshad pa la gsum ste/ skye tshul/ ngo bo/ 'bras bu'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyu'i rkyen rigs bdag po'i rkyen de ston byed kyi bstan bcos dang dge bshes dmigs rkyen bde ba med pa sdug bsngal gyis non pa bde ba can chags sdang can gyi sems can te rkyen bzhi tshang ba las skye'o// gnyis pa (ngo bo )ni/ bde ba dang phrad 'dod sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod bde ba dang mi 'bral bar 'dod pa de rnams sems can thams cad la khyad med par sgrub 'dod de/ go rim bzhin gnod sems/ rnam 'tshe/ mi dga' ba/ chags sdang med pa'i dge rtsa rnams so/ /gsum pa ('bras bu )ni/ gnas skabs mthar thug gnyis kar don gnyis rgya chen po 'grub bo// tshogs sgrub bcu bdun/

gsum pa tshogs bcu bdun gyi sgrub pa la gnyis te/ spyir bstan pa/ 'ga' zhig bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ brtse dang sbyin la sogs pa drug/ zhi gnas lhag mthong bcas pa dang*// zung du 'brel ba'i lam gang dang*// thabs la mkhas pa gang yin dang*// ye shes dang ni bsod nams dang*// lam dang gzungs dang sa bcu dang*// gnyen po tshogs kyi sgrub pa yi// rim pa yin par shes par bya// tshul de rnams kyis theg chen du zhugs pa'i tshe/ tshogs gnyis mthu can du 'gyur bas tshogs sgrub bshad pa la bcu bdun las/ bsam pa brtse ba chen po'i tshogs dang*/ mdo ni/ sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi sdug bsngal rab tu bcil nas zhes sogs te dang po'o/ /tshogs dang zhes pa 'og ma rnams la yang ngo*// sbyor ba sbyin pa la sogs pa'i phyin drug dang*/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin la gnas shing zhes pa nas/ sems can rnams dge bcu'i lam la 'god do zhes sogs te bdun no/ /mnyam par bzhag pa gzhan don la rtse gcig pa'i zhi gnas te/ rnam mkhyen nyid dang ldan pa'i sems kyi gnas zhes sogs te brgyad pa'o/ /zhi gnas zhes pa'i don ni rnam g.yeng zhi nas sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa'o// de'i dmigs pa la mtshan ma dang mtshan med gnyis rang ngo la 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa gnyis yod/ sems gnas pa'i thabs ni dgu ste/ dang por dmigs pa la sems 'jog par byed/ yun srings nas rgyun du 'jog par byed/ 'phro na slar glan te 'jog par byed/ mi 'phro ba'i phyir dran pa dang bcas te nye bar 'jog par byed/ 'dod yon la mi blta bar sems 'dul bar byed/ rnam g.yeng la nyes dmigs su blta bas sems zhi bar byed/ rnam rtog mngon gyur byung yang dang du mi len pas rab tu zhi bar byed/ bying rgod bkag nas sems rtse gcig tu byed/ goms pa na 'bad med du mnyam par 'jog par byed pa'o/ /de'i tshe gnas tshul rtogs pa'i lhag mthong dang bcas pa dang*/
rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi slad du go cha ma mchis pa'i zhes sogs te dgu pa'o//

'di'i sgra don ni/ don gyi gnas tshul la dpyad nas zhugs pas de mi bslu bar lhag gi mthong ba'am thob pa'o/ /dpyad zhugs kyi lhag mthong mos spyod na yang yod/ thob pa'i lhag mthong 'das lam kho na la'o/ /des ni ma rtogs log rtog gsum ga sel lo/ /ngo bo ni shes rab ste/ gang zag dang chos kyi bdag 'dzin dang bral ba'i dbye bas gnyis yod do/ /zab pa dang rgya che ba gnyis zung du 'brel ba'i lam gang yin pa dang*/ ma bcings ma grol ba de yis rnam mkhyen nyid du zhes sogs te bcu pa'o// mnyam par ma bzhag par sems can sgrol ba'i thabs la mkhas pa gang yin pa dang*/ phyi nang gi dngos po yongs su gtong ste de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas nas zhes te bcu gcig pa'o// lta ba ye shes dang ni theg pa chen po ni 'di lta ste nang stong pa nyid dang zhes sogs te bcu gnyis pa'o// spyod pa ting nge 'dzin du ma la brten pa'i bsod nams gsog pa dang*/ 'di lta ste dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang zhes sogs te bcu gsum pa'o// 'bras bu sgrub pa'i lam byang phyogs sde tshan bdun/ rnam thar sgo gsum/ shes pa bcu gcig /dbang po gsum/ ting nge 'dzin gsum/ rjes dran bcu/ tshad med bzhi/ bsam gtan bzhi/ gzugs med bzhi/ rnam thar brgyad/ mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu/ stobs bcu/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ so sor rig pa bzhi/ ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad de sde tshan nyer gcig dang*/ 'di lta ste dran pa nyer bar bzhag pa bzhi dang zhes sogs te bcu bzhi pa'o// legs pa'i lam mi brjed pa'i gzungs dang*/ a zhes bya ba ni ma skyes pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /zhes sogs te bco lnga pa'o// gzungs 'di la bzhi yod pa las/ dang po tshig gam chos kyi gzungs ni/ sar zhugs kyi sems dpa' la mnga' ste/ ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs rgya chen po thos pa'i mod la zin cing mi brjed pa'o/

/don gyi gzungs ni/ de dag gi don rtogs shing mi brjed pa'o/ /bzod pa'i gzungs ni/ sbyor lam bzod pa nas ldan te/ a zhes pa skye med mtshon pa nges par byas nas de'i don gyi chos thams cad la rgyas gdab ste sgom pas goms pa rdzogs pa na chos thams cad ma skyes par rtogs pa'i bzod pa thob nus pa lta bu'o/ /gsang sngags kyi gzungs ni/ sar gnas kyi sems dpa' rnams kyis sngags kyi ye ge la byin gyis brlabs pas/ sngags des rims nad sogs 'joms nus pa lta bu'o/ /de rnams las dang po gnyis gzungs dngos yin la/ phyi ma gnyis ni byang sems de'i rgyud kyis de dang de'i nus pa 'dzin pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'o// bcu drug pa ni/ yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i sa bcu dang*/ nyes pa sel ba'i gnyen po'i tshogs kyi sgrub pa yis ni bcu bdun pa ste de dag gi mdo ni 'og nas 'chad do// de rnams kyi rim pa ni theg pa la gnas nas go cha chen po bgos par 'jog byed dang*/ theg pa rang gi ngo bo gnyis yod pas dang po ni sgrub pa dang po bcu'o// gnyis pa la bgrod byed lam/ mthar phyin pa'i rgyu gnyis yod pas dang po ni/ sgrub pa de 'og lnga'o/ /gnyis pa ni sgrub pa mtha' ma gnyis te/ sgrub pa de dag phyi ma phyi ma snga ma snga ma las byung ba'i 'brel ba can yin par shes par bya'o// ye shes kyi tshogs/ gnyis pa 'ga' zhig khyad par du bshad pa la gsum ste/ ye shes kyi tshogs/ sa'i tshogs/ gnyen po'i tshogs bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams so/ /dang po ni/ bar du bdag zlog gi skabs dang bstun nas kun rdzob pa'i chos kun stong par khong du chub pa las dbye bar mdzad pas 'di skabs kyi stong gzhi ni stong bya'i chos can la bya'i/ /stong gzhi go chod po 'gyur med yongs grub ni ma yin te/ de ni blo las 'das shing bgrang du med pa'i phyir/ des na mig sogs nang gi chos dang*/

gzugs sogs phyi'i chos dang*/ phyi nang gnyis kar gyur pa dbang rten lus dang*/ stong pa'i dngos po stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes dang*/ rgya chen po phyogs bcu dang*/ don dam pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam dang*/ rgyu rkyen 'dus byas pa las skyes pa khams gsum dang*/ de las cig shos nam mkha' la sogs pa'i 'dus ma byas pa dang*/ mtha' las 'das pa rtag chad dang bral ba'i rten 'brel dang*/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa 'khor ba dang*/ dge phyogs dor ba med pa byang phyogs sogs dang*/ 'phags pa rnams kyi shes mthong gis ma mdzad pa'i chos rnams kyi rang bzhin dang*/ 'dus byas ma byas kyi chos thams cad dang*/ chos rnams kyi skye ba dang*/ gzugs rung sogs mtshan nyid dang*/ phan tshun mi dmigs pa 'das ma 'ongs sogs dus dang*/ tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid dang*/ cig shos phung po lnga'i dngos po dang*/ nam mkha' sogs dngos po med pa dang*/ chos rnams kyi rang gi ngo bo stong pa nyid dang*/ tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi chos las gzhan 'phags pa'i spyod yul gyi ngo bo nyid rnams rang rang gi ngo bo stong pa nyid yin la/ de ltar yul nyi shu po la bden stong sgyu ma ltar dmigs nas rtogs pa'i ye shes kyang nyi shu'o/ /grangs 'di ni 'phags seng gnyis kyi bzhed pa ltar te/ mdo las thog mar stong nyid bcu drug gud nas tha ma bzhi gsungs pa rnams bsdoms pa yin no// gnyis pa (sa mtshams )ni/ dang po gsum ni mos spyod na spyir bzhag bzhi pa ni chos mchog la/ de 'og bdun ni sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar la/ de 'og gnyis dang gnyis dang gnyis rnams dag sa gsum la/ de 'og gsum sangs rgyas kyi sar bzhag go /de'i tshe mos spyod du rjes mthun dang gzhan rnams su mngon sum du rtogs so// sa'i tshogs/ gnyis pa sa'i tshogs la gnyis te/ sa'i rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa/ yongs sbyong gi khyad par gzhung dang sbyar nas so sor bshad pa'o/

/dang po (sa'i rnam bzhag spyir bstan pa )la/ mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum/ spang bya'i rnam bzhag go /dang po (mtshan nyid )ni/ bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rang bzhin yon tan gyi rten du gyur pa'o// gnyis pa (mtshon bya )ni/ bhū ma'i sgra las gong nas gong du bgrod pa'i don ni spyir bzhag la so so'i sgra bshad ni 'og nas rim pas 'chad do/ /gsum pa (mtshan gzhi )la gsum ste/ dbye ba/ grangs nges/ khyad par gyi chos so/ /dang po ni/ phar phyin bcu la so sor 'jug pa'i sgo nas bcur dbye'o/ /gnyis pa (grangs nges )ni/ sbyong byed kyi chos bcur yod pas de ltar bzhag go/ gsum pa (khyad par gyi chos )ni/ rjes thob tu sgyu ma ltar bsod nams gsog pa dang*/ rtogs zin pa'i chos nyid la nges pa bskyed pa'i gnas skabs sa'i tshogs su gyur pa dang*/ mnyam bzhag tu kun rdzob kyi 'khrul snang bcad nas don dam rang bzhin gyi yod pa'i snang ba la dmigs pa sgrib gnyis drungs 'byin byed ye shes dang gnyen po'i tshogs su gyur pa gnyis gnyis su rnam par bzhag la/ sa rnams su chos nyid rtogs tshul ni/ dper na/ nam mkha' la sprin zad rim gyis nam mkha' mthong ba je cher 'gro ba de'i tshe/ nam mkha' la cha shas med kyang sprin bral ba'i sgo nas cha shas 'jog pa ltar*/ rtogs bya la cha shas med kyang rang rgyud kyi 'khrul pa zad rim gyis mngon rtogs kyang gong 'phel du 'gyur ro// des na khyad par de las sa dang por chos nyid de bdag gzhan thams cad la khyab pa kun 'gro'i don/ gnyis par chos nyid la sgrib byed kyi dri ma spang rung du rtogs pa mchog gi don/ gsum par theg chen gyi chos thos pa ni chos nyid rtogs pa'i rgyu mthun pa'i don/ bzhi par chos nyid la sred pas yongs su 'dzin pa med pa'i don/ lnga par mnyam pa nyid bcu rig pas bdag gzhan gyi rgyud kyi chos nyid tha dad med pa'i don/

drug par nyon mngos rnam dag ma yin pa glo bur ba'i don/ bdun par mdo sogs chos tsam gyi mtshan ma tha dad mi 'byung bas mtshan 'dzin bral ba'i don/ brgyad par kun byang bri gang med par rtogs shing nyon yid kyi sa bon gnas gyur pas rnam par mi rtog pa dang*/ dbang shes gnas gyur pas zhing dag pa la dbang ba'i gnas su/ dgu pa dang bcu par yid shes gnas gyur pas rim bzhin so so rang rig gi ye shes dang ji ltar 'dod bzhin 'gro don bgyi ba'i phrin las la dbang ba'i gnas rnams su rtogs so/ /gzhan yang zhugs pa dang rmi lam gyi rtags dang*/ spyi dang bye brag gi yon tan dang*/ skye ba len tshul/ phar phyin la spyod tshul gyi khyad par rnams 'dir yi ge bsdu ba'i phyir ma smos so// bzhi pa (spang bya'i rnam bzhag )la gsum ste/ shes sgrib/ nyon sgrib/ ji ltar spong tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ spyir shes sgrib gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ khyad par sa re re la shin tu rmongs pa gnyis gnyis de'i gnas ngan len re rer yod de/ 'di ltar sa dang por gang zag dang chos la zhen pa dang ngan song ba'i nyon mongs pa'i dang*/ gnyis par ltung ba phra mo'i 'khrul pa dang las kyi rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i dang*/ gsum par 'dod chags kyi dang thob pa'i gzungs yongs su ma rdzogs pa'i dang*/ bzhi par snyoms 'jug la sred pa dang chos la sred pa'i dang*/ lnga par 'khor ba la cig tu mi phyogs shing mngon du phyogs pa dang myang 'das la cig tu mi phyogs shing mngon du phyogs pa'i dang*/ drug pa 'du byed 'byung ba mngon sum du bya ba dang*/ gzugs sogs mtshan ma mang po 'byung ba'i dang*/ bdun par chos tsam gyi mtshan ma phra mo 'byung ba dang*/ mtshan med yid la byed pas thabs la dang*/ brgyad par mtshan med la rtsol ba dang mtshan ma rnams la mi dbang ba'i dang*/ dgu par chos ston pa dang chos kyi tshig dang yi ge tshad med pa dang gong nas gong du shes rab spobs pa gzungs kyi dbang thob pa dang*/

spobs pa la dbang thob pa'i dang*/ bcu par mngon shes chen po dang gsang ba phra mo la 'jug pa'i dang*/ bcu gcig par shes bya kun la ma chags ma thogs pa'i sgrib byed chags thogs kyis shin tu rmongs pa'o zhes dgongs pa nges 'grel las gsungs so// gnyis pa (nyon sgrib )la/ mthong sgom gyi spang bya gnyis/ dang po (mthong lam gyi spang bya )ni/ log par zhugs tshul gyi phye na/ dngos su/ brgyud nas/ dbang gi log zhugs gsum/ dang po (dngos su log zhugs )ni/ lta ba dang po gsum ma rig pa dang the tshom ste rim bzhin bden pa la bdag dang bdag gir dang*/ rtag chad du dang*/ bden pa med par 'dzin pa dang*/ bden pa'i mtshan nyid la rmongs pa dang*/ de las bstan pa ltar yin min the tshom za ba ste bden pa la nyon mongs gzhan gyis bar ma chod par 'jug/ gnyis pa (brgyud nas log zhugs )ni/ lta ba dang tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin dang 'dod chags dang nga rgyal te rim pas/ lta ngan la mchog tu dang*/ de dang 'brel ba'i spyod ngan la mchog tu 'dzin pa dang*/ de dag gi sems khengs pa dang de dag la sred pa ste bden par dmigs pa'i nyon mongs la dmigs nas 'jug/ gsum pa (dbang gi log zhugs )ni/ khong khro ste rang lta dang mi mthun pa la mnar sems pa'i dbang gis 'jug go /nyon mongs pas 'gog lam gyi bden pa dngos la mi dmigs kyang ming tsam la dmigs pa'o/ /log par 'jug gzhi bden pa bzhi la 'jug tshul sdug kun la phan tshun rgyu byed pas dang 'gog lam la skrag pa'i sgo nas so/ /de'i phyir bden pa'i gnas tshul mthong ba na nyon mongs bzlog pa'o// gnyis pa (sgom lam gyi spang bya )ni/ nyon mongs lhan skyes drug po rnams te yul la log zhugs so// gsum pa (ji ltar spong tshul )la/ theg pa che chung gi lugs gnyis/ dang po (theg chen gyi lugs )ni/ gang zag gi bdag med dang chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa la sgrib byed la ni/

rim pas nyon mongs pa can dang*/ nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa'i ma rig pa zhes bya la/ dang po la 'khor bar 'ching byed dngos dang des bzhag pa'i bag chags 'dod chags kyi cha gnyis/ phyi ma la'ang rang bzhin rnam dag dang glo bur rnam dag la sgrib byed gnyis yod cing*/ de dag gi snga ma snga ma sa dang po dang*/ phyi ma phyi ma sgom lam du spong ngo*// des na mthong lam skad cig bcu drug gi dbang du byas na sdug bsngal chos bzod kyis khams gsum ga'i sdug bsngal mthong spangs sgrib pa gnyis ka spong*/ chos shes kyis rnam grol lam mngon du byed/ rjes bzod kyis snga ma gnyis dang rjes shes kyis rjes bzod la dmigs nas 'phags chos kyi rgyur 'dzin/ lhag ma rnams kyang rigs 'gre'o/ /skad cig ma'i dbang du byas na mthong spangs thams cad dus mtha'i skad cig la spong ngo*// sgom spangs ni/ sa gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar sgom lam chung 'bring skor gsum gsum gyis rtog pa dang nyon mongs che 'bring skor gsum gsum spong*/ dag sa ste sgom lam chen po skor gsum gyis rtog pa chung ngu skor gsum spong zhing*/ spong tshul ni cig car ba kho na'o// gnyis pa(theg dman gyi lugs )ni/ 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal mthong spangs rnams sdug bsngal la chos bzod chos shes/ khams gong gi rnams sdug bsngal rjes bzod rjes shes kyis spong zhing gzhan yang des mtshon no/ /sgom spangs rnams rim can dang cig car spong ba gnyis ka yod do/ /de yang 'jig rten pa'i sgom lam gyis zhi rags su blta bas nyon mongs mngon gyur mgo non pa tsam yin la/ 'phags lam bden pa mngon rtogs kyis ni bag nyal yang drungs nas 'byin pa'o// gnyis pa yongs sbyong gi khyad par gzhung dang sbyar ba la gnyis te/ rgyu sa dgu'i yongs sbyongs/ 'bras bu sa bcu pa'i mtshan nyid bshad pa'o/ /dang po (rgyu sa dgu'i yongs sbyongs )la/ sa gang dang gang la gnas pa'i tshe sa de nyid kyi dri ma rang skabs kyi rjes thob tu sbyong zhing sa gong ma'i yon tan thob phyir du yang sbyong ba yin pas de 'chad pa la dgu las/

dang po (sa dang po'i yongs sbyongs )la/ sbyong byed thabs/ sbyong tshul shes rab bo/ /dang po ni/ yongs su sbyong ba rnam bcu yis// sa ni dang po 'thob 'gyur te// bsam dang phan pa'i dngos nyid dang*// sems can rnams la sems mnyam nyid// gtong dang bshes gnyen bsten pa dang*// dam chos dmigs pa 'tshol ba dang*// rtag tu nges 'byung sems nyid dang*// sangs rgyas sku 'dod dga' ba dang*// chos ston pa dang bden pa yi// tshig ni bcu pa yin par 'dod// yongs su sbyong ba rnam bcu yis/ /sa ni dang po sngon ma thob pa'i chos nyid rtogs pas rab tu dga' ba dang ldan pa de thob par 'gyur te/ dge ba sgrub pa'i lhag bsam dang*/ phan pa'i dngos po sgo gsum gyi bya ba nyid sgrub pa dang*/ sems can rnams la sems mnyam pa nyid du tshad med bzhi sgrub pa dang*/ dngos po rnams 'khor gsum dag pas gtong ba dang*/ rnam mkhyen la 'god pa'i bshes gnyen la bsten pa dang*/ theg gsum gyi dam chos la dmigs pa nas don 'tshol ba dang*/ rtag tu khyim nas nges par 'byung ba'i sems nyid dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi skur sgrub 'dod pa'i dga' ba dang*/ sems can smin byed chos ston pa dang*/ zol med bden par smra ba'i tshig ni yongs sbyong bcu pa yin par 'dod do//

gnyis pa (sbyong tshul shes rab )ni/ 'di dag rang bzhin mi dmigs pas// yongs su sbyong bar shes par bya// zhes pa ste 'di phyi ma rnams la yang sbyar ro/ /mdo ni/ sa dang po la gnas pas yongs su sbyong ba bcu po 'di dag bya ste/ zhes so// sa gnyis pa 'chal tshul dang dman lam yid byed kyi dri ma med pa ni/ tshul khrims byas pa gzo dang bzod// rab tu dga' dang snying brtse che// bkur sti bla ma la gus nyan// brgyad pa sbyin la sogs la brtson// tshul khrims gsum dang*/ gzhan gyi byas pa la drin du gzo ba dang*/ gnod pa la bzod pa dang*/ dge ba'i chos sgrub pa la mi 'gyod par rab tu dga' ba dang*/ sems can kun la snying brtse che ba dang*/ bla ma la bkur stir brtson pa dang*/ bla ma la gus pas dam chos nyan pa dang*/ yongs sbyongs brgyad pa ni/ sbyin pa la sogs phyin drug la brtson pa rnams so/ /sa gnyis pa la gnas pa'i byang sems kyis chos brgyad yid la bya ste/ zhes so// sa gsum pa ting nge 'dzin gyi mthus rang gzhan la chos kyi snang ba byed pa'i 'od byed pa ni/ thos pas mi ngoms nyid dang ni// zang zing med par chos sbyin dang*// sangs rgyas zhing kun sbyong ba dang*// 'khor bas yongs su mi skyo dang*// ngo tsha khrel yod ces bya ba*// rlom med bdag nyid de rnam lnga// sangs rgyas kyi gsung thos pas mi ngoms pa nyid dang ni zang zing gi rnyed pa la ltos pa med par chos sbyin pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi snod bcud kyi zhing kun sbyong ba dang 'khor ba'i nyes pas yongs su mi skyo ba dang*/ nyan rang gi sems las bzlog pa ngo tsha dang khrel yod pa ces bya ba la rlom sems med pa'i bdag nyid de yongs sbyong rnam pa lnga'o/ /byang sems chen po sa gsum pa la gnas pas chos lnga la gnas par bya ste/ zhes so// sa bzhi pa byang chub phyogs mthun gyi shes rab kyis sgrib gnyis bsreg pa'i me'i 'od 'phro ba ni/ nags gnas 'dod chung chog shes dang*//

sbyangs pa yang dag sdom rten dang*// bslab pa yongs su mi gtong dang*// 'dod pa rnams la smod pa dang*// mya ngan 'das dang bdog kun gtong*// mi zhum pa dang lta ba med// dben pa'i nags su gnas pa dang rang don du byang chub kyang mi 'dod pa 'dod pa chung ba dang*/ rnyed pa la chog shes pa dang*/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu+u gnyis yang dag pa'i sdom rten du bzung ba dang*/ bslab pa gsum srog gi phyir yang yongs su mi gtong ba dang*/ 'dod pa'i yon tan rnams la mi dga' bas smod pa dang*/ gdul bya rnams ji ltar 'tsham pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam la sbyor bar brtson pa dang*/ lus la sogs pa'i bdog pa kun gtong ba dang*/ dge phyogs la sems mi zhum pa dang*/ dngos por 'dzin pa'i lta ba med pa ste yongs sbyong bcu'o/ /byang sems chen po sa bzhi pa la gnas pas chos bcu po 'di dag yongs su btang bar mi bya'o/ zhes so// sa lnga pa sems can smin pa dang rang sems nyon mongs par mi 'gyur ba ste bya dka' ba gnyis byed pa'i sbyang dka' ba ni/ 'dris dang khyim la 'khren pa dang*// 'du 'dzir gyur pa'i gnas dang ni// bdag bstod gzhan la brnyas pa dang*// mi dge'i las kyi lam bcu dang*// rlom pas khengs dang phyin ci log/ blo ngan dang ni nyon mongs bzod// bcu po 'di ni rnam spangs na// sa lnga pa ni yang dag 'thob// khyim pa dang rab byung la ha cang 'dris pa dang rang gi sbyin bdag gi khyim la 'khren pa ste ser sna byed pa dang 'du 'dzi yod par gyur pa'i gnas bsten pa dang ni bdag nyid bstod pa dang*/ gzhan la brnyas pa dang srog gcod sogs mi dge ba'i las kyi lam bcu dang*/ yon tan gyi rlom pas khengs pa dang blang dor phyin ci log tu zhen pa dang log par lta ba'i blo ngan pa dang ni/ nyon mongs bzod pa de la skyon du mi blta bar rjes su 'brang ba ste skyon bcu po 'di ni rnam par spangs shing yongs su sbyang na sa lnga pa ni yang dag 'thob bo/

/byang sems chen po sa lnga pa la gnas pas chos bcu yongs su spang bar bya ste/ zhes so// sa drug pa sher phyin la brten nas 'khor 'das la mi gnas pa'i phyir 'khor 'das mngon du gyur pa ni/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus// bsam gtan shes rab rab rdzogs pas// slob ma dang ni bse ru la// dga' dang skrag pa'i sems spangs pa// bslangs na mi zhum bdog pa kun// gtong yang mi dga' med pa dang*// dbul yang slong ba mi spong bas// sa ni drug pa yang dag 'thob// sbyin pa dang tshul khrims dang bzod pa dang brtson 'grus dang bsam gtan dang shes rab ste phyin drug rab tu rdzogs pas lam bskyed pa drug dang*/ slob ma nyan thos dang ni bse ru rang sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la dga' ba spangs pa gnyis dang*/ zab rgyas la skrag pa'i sems spangs pa dang slong pos blangs na sems mi zhum pa dang*/ bdog pa kun gtong yang mi dga' ba med pa dang*/ rang dbul yang slong ba mi spong ba ste lam min spong ba drug dang bcu gnyis kyis sa ni drug pa yang dag par thob pa'i yongs sbyong ngo*/ /byang chen sa drug pa la gnas pas chos drug yongs su rdzogs par bya ste/ zhes dang*/ gzhan yang chos drug yongs su spang bar bya ste/ zhes so// sa bdun pa bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam dang 'brel bas mtshan mar 'dzin pa las ring du song ba'i yongs sbyong la/ spang bya/ blang bya gnyis/ dang po (spang bya )ni/ bdag dang sems can 'dzin pa dang*// srog dang gang zag chad rtag dang*// mtshan ma rgyu dang phung po dang*// khams dang skye mched dag dang ni// khams gsum po la gnas dang chags// sems ni kun tu zhum pa dang*// dkon mchog gsum dang tshul khrims la// der lta ba yi mngon zhen dang*// stong pa nyid la rtsod pa dang*// de dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa ni// nyi shu gang la rnam chad pa// de yis sa ni bdun pa 'thob// bdag dang sems can du 'dzin pa dang*/ srog dang gang zag dang chad pa dang rtag pa dang*/

mtshan ma nyon mongs dang tha dad pa'i rgyur 'dzin pa ni nyon sgrib kyi cha brgyad dang*/ phung po dang khams dang skye mched dag dang ni khams gsum po la gnas par 'dzin pa dang de dag la chags pa dang 'khor ba las 'da' mi nus so snyam nas sems ni kun tu zhum pa dang drug ni shes sgrib gzhi la mtshan mar spyod pa/ dkon mchog gsum dang tshul khrims la de dang der mtshan mar lta ba'i mngon zhen dang bcas pa ni lam la mtshan mar spyod pa bzhi/ chos can glo bur ba stong pa'i don nyid la rtsod pa dang*/ de ltar gsungs pa dang de bzhin nyid mi stong bar gsungs pa 'gal bar sems pa ni rnam pa la mtshan mar 'dzin pa gnyis te nyes pa ni nyi shu gang la rnam par chad cing spangs pa na de yis sa ni bdun pa thob bo// gnyis pa (blang bya )ni/ rnam thar sgo gsum shes pa dang*// 'khor gsum rnam par dag nyid dang*// snying rje dang ni rlom med dang*// chos mnyam nyid dang tshul gcig shes// mi skye ba dang bzod shes dang*// chos rnams rnam pa gcig tu ston// rtog pa kun tu 'joms pa dang*// 'du shes lta dang nyon mongs spong*// zhi gnas nges par sems pa dang*// lhag mthong la ni mkhas pa dang*// sems dul ba dang thams cad la// thogs pa med pa'i ye shes dang*// chags pa'i sa min gar 'dod par// zhing gzhan du ni mnyam 'gro dang*// kun tu bdag gi ngo bo ni// ston pa nyid dang nyi shu'o// stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang smon pa med pa ste rnam thar sgo gsum shes pa dang 'khor gsum rnam par dag pas dge bcu sgrub pa nyid dang*/ ris med pa'i snying rje chen po dang ni gang la yang rlom pa med pa dang kun rdzob pa'i chos thams cad mi dmigs par mnyam pa nyid dang don dam pa'i tshul gcig tu shes pa dang brgyad ni nyon sgrib kyi gnyen po/ chos thams cad mi skye bar shes pa dang chos zab mo la bzod pa shes pa dang*/ chos rnams theg chen gyi don gyi rnam pa gcig tu ston pa dang*/

rnam par rtog pa kun tu 'joms pa dang mtshan ma'i 'du shes lta ba lnga dang chags sogs nyon mongs spong ba dang*/ rnam mkhyen rtse gcig pa'i zhi gnas nges par sems pa dang drug gzhi la rtog pa'i gnyen po/ lhag mthong gis shes rab la ni mkhas pa dang sems dul ba dang chos thams cad la rmongs pa'i thogs pa med pa'i ye shes dang yul la sems chags pa'i sa min pa shes pa dang bzhi lam ma rtogs pa'i gnyen po/ rang gar 'dod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan dang gzhan du ni cig car dus mnyam du 'gro ba dang*/ kun tu bdag gi lus kyi ngo bo ni sprul pa sna tshogs su ston pa nyid dang ni rnam pa la rtog pa'i gnyen po gnyis te/ sangs rgyas kyi drung du phyin nas sgro 'dogs gcod pas so/ /de ltar na nyi shu'o/ /byang sems sa bdun pa la gnas pa la chos nyi shu mi 'byung ste/ zhes dang*/ byang chen sa bdun pa la gnas pas chos nyi shu po 'di dag rdzogs par bya ste/ zhes so// sa brgyad pa mtshan ma dang mtshan med la rtsol ba'i 'du shes gnyis kyis mi g.yo ba ni/ sems can kun yid shes pa dang*// mngon par shes pas brtse ba dang*// sangs rgyas zhing bzang sgrub pa dang*// yongs su brtag phyir sangs rgyas bsten// dbang po shes dang rgyal ba yi// zhing sbyong sgyu ma ltar gnas dang*// bsam bzhin srid pa len pa dang*// las ni rnam pa 'di brgyad bshad// sems can kun gyi yid kyi spyod pa shes pa dang dag ma dag gi zhing sna tshogs su gzhan don gyi phyir rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon par shes pas brtse ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing bzang po sgrub pa dang gnas snang gi chos yongs su brtag pa'i phyir sangs rgyas bsten pa dang lha'i mig gi dbang pos 'chi 'pho skye ba shes pa dang*/ snod bcud ni rgyal ba'i zhing du sbyong ba dang bya byed las gsum sgyu ma ltar gnas pa dang bsam bzhin rang dbang du srid par skye ba len pa dang ste yongs sbyong gi las ni rnam pa 'di brgyad bshad do/

/byang chen sa brgyad pa la gnas pas chos bzhi po 'di dag yongs su rdzogs par bya ste/ zhes dang*/ gzhan yang chos bzhi zhes so// sa dgu pa chos ston pa la mkhas pa'i so so yang dag par rig pa'i blo gros bzang po thob pas na legs pa'i blo gros ni/ smon lam dag ni mtha' yas dang*// lha la sogs pa'i skad shes dang*// spobs pa chu bo lta bu dang*// mngal du 'jug pa mchog dang ni// rigs dang rus dang cho 'brang dang*// 'khor dang skye ba dag dang ni// nges 'byung byang chub shing rnams dang*// yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yin// ji ltar smon pa bzhin 'grub pa'i smon lam dag ni mtha' yas dang chos ston pa'i phyir lha la sogs pa'i 'gro ba'i skad shes pa dang*/ zil gyis mi gnon pa'i spobs pa chu bo lta bu rgyun mi 'chad pa dang*/ rdzus skyes sogs min pa skyon med pa'i mngal du 'jug pa mchog nyid dang ni rgyal rigs sogs 'jig rten na mchog tu grags pa dang*/ nyi ma'i gnyen sogs rus mchog dang pha ma sogs gnyen bshes rnams bdun rgyud tshun chad du chos la spyod pa'i cho 'brang mchog rnams su skye ba dang*/ rang gi 'khor dag pa 'du ba dang rtsib ma'i go bar sogs nas skye ba dag dang ni sangs rgyas rnams kyis nges par 'byung bar bskul ba dang*/ dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i byang chub shing drung rnams su gnas pa dang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa stobs bcu sogs rdzogs pa la brtson par byed de yongs sbyong bcu gnyis yin/ byang chen sa dgu pa la gnas pas chos bcu gnyis yongs su rdzogs par bya ste/ zhes so// gnyis pa 'bras bu sa bcu pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ sa dgu 'das nas ye shes ni// gang gis sangs rgyas sar gnas pa// de ni byang chub sems dpa'i sa// bcu pa yin par shes par bya// nyan thos kyi sa bdun rang rgyal gyi sa gcig byang sems kyi sa dgu gcig tu bgrangs shing*/ de ltar sa dgu las 'das nas yon tan thams cad yar ldan du gyur pa'i ye shes de ni byang sems kyi sa yin kyang rgyu mtshan gang gis rjes thob tu sangs rgyas sprul pa'i skur ston nus pas sangs rgyas kyi sar gnas pa zhes brjod rung ba yin la/

yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos ni ma yin no/ /de ni byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu pa'i gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin kyi sgo gnyis kyis thos pa'i chos kyi rten la gnas pa nam mkha' ltar khyab cing chos kyi char 'bebs pa'i chos kyi sprin gyi mtshan nyid yin par shes par bya'o/ /rab 'byor de ltar byang sems chen po sa dgu las yongs su 'das nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la gnas pa ste/ rab 'byor de ni byang sems kyi sa bcu pa'o/ zhes so// nyan thos kyi sa bdun ni/ rigs kyi sa/ brgyad pa'i sa/ mthong ba'i sa/ bsrabs pa'i sa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa/ byas pa rtogs pa'i sa/ nyan thos kyi sa rnams te/ rim pas chos mchog dang*/ rgyun zhugs zhugs pa/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas/ phyir 'ong*/ phyir mi 'ong*/ dgra bcom 'bras gnas gsum de gsum gyi zhugs pa'i skabs rnams la bzhag pa yin no// gnyen po'i tshogs/ gsum pa gnyen po'i tshogs ni/ mthong dang goms pa'i lam dag la// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog rnams// nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i phyir// gnyen po rnam pa brgyad ces bya// mthong ba dang*/ de goms par byed pa'i sgom pa'i lam gyi mnyam bzhag gi skabs dag la so sor spang bya gzung rtog gnyis dang*/ 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gnyis rnams bag nyal dang bcas pa nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ de'i cha nas bzhag pa'i gnyen po yang mthong sgom gnyis la bzhi bzhi ste rnam pa brgyad ces bya'o/ /mdo ni/ bden pa gnyis ka'i rnam pa la brten pa'i lan gyis gsungs te/ theg chen des gang nas nges par 'byung zhes dris pa'i lan du/ nges par 'byung sa 'byung byed 'byung tshul rnams khas blangs pa'i kun rdzob pa'i lan gyis mthong spangs gnyen po dang*/ 'byung sa sogs mi dmigs pa'i don dam pa'i lan gyis sgom spangs gnyen po gsungs so// nges 'byung sgrub pa/ bzhi pa nges 'byung sgrub pa brgyad bshad pa ni/ ched du bya dang mnyam nyid dang*//

sems can don dang 'bad med dang*// mtha' las 'das par nges 'byung dang*// thob pa'i mtshan nyid nges 'byung dang*// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid dang*// lam gyi yul can nges 'byung ste// rnam pa brgyad kyi bdag nyid 'di// nges 'byung bsgrub pa yin shes bya// tshogs rdzogs pas 'bras bu mthar thug thob nges pa'i phyir/ chos ma lus pa mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i rnam pas ched du bya ba gsum dang*/ chos thams cad mnyam nyid du rtogs pa dang*/ sems can gyi don tshad med pa sgrub pa dang*/ de dag la 'bad rtsol med par lhun grub tu 'byung ba dang*/ rtag chad kyi mtha' las 'das par nges 'byung dang*/ theg gsum gyi yon tan thob pa'i gtan du ba'i mtshan nyid can gyi nges 'byung dang drug ni nges par 'byung tshul/ dbyings dang ye shes ro gcig tu gyur pa rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid mi slob pa mthar thug dang*/ de thob par byed pa'i lam gyi yul can gyi ye shes sa bcu pa'i khyad par lam slob lam mthar thug gnyis ni nges par 'byung ba'i sgo nas bzhag pa ste/ mdor na rnam pa brgyad kyi bdag nyid ni nges 'byung sgrub pa yin zhing snga ma snga ma phyi ma phyi ma la ltos pa'i 'brel ba can yin par shes par bya'o/ /mdo ni/ theg pa chen po 'dis lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten zil gyis mnan te 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes sogs so//
